NAME: Lucky
TEXT: This handsome boy is very compliant to instruction. He is relaxed and mellow to be around. He does like his own toys and is comfortable on his own. He has visits from young kids and gets along with everyone he meets. He comes inside and likes keeping you company.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Come and meet Mr Personality himself, Benny, at Western Sydney! Whether it's posing for photos or playing with toys, Benny has an amazing personality he can't wait to share with you. This sweet, handsome, happy and charming boy is very friendly and will love to soak up attention from anyone. He loves food BUT! He loves toys more, and is a very motivated and eager to please type boy. He engages with enrichment like a champ, showing off his skills as he works through puzzle toys and snuffle mats, keeping him entertained while you're gone. He can coexist nicely with other greyhounds and can be rehomed along side one, but doesn't seem to need a dog friend in his life and would be comfortable as a solo pet. Older kids would suit Benny as he does like to check out what treats or toys might be in your hands! Benny dreams of a townhouse/backyard with an outdoor area, and would be happy to show you his skills on staircases if you have stair access. As a solo pet, a half day left alone is suitable at this stage. Meet this one of a kind boy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Buster
TEXT: Happy, friendly and confident young boy Buster loves people, and will seek out attention from you and strangers on walks! This handsome and charismatic guy would love a house with a yard, and doesn't mind if you go to work during the day as he settles well and can handle some independence. Buster's best home would be with older kids as he loves to see what's in your hand if you have treats! He is a big ball of love, fun and curiosity, and still being young, making him great for a family or active couple. He loves toys and food and all things fun. A home with a female canine companion would suit Buster the best. This ladies man aims to please and has already learnt stairs, and has been polite with small dogs on lead, making him perfect for you if you're looking for an eager to please young greyhound. Meet Buster at Western Sydney!

NAME: George
TEXT: Meet George – your future best mate! 🐾 George is a happy, friendly, and outgoing boy who absolutely loves people. He’s especially great with kids aged 5–15 and enjoys all the pats, attention, and playtime you can give. If you’re looking for a dog who truly lights up around his family, George is your guy! He'll be right by your side. He has those fun little bursts of energy that make life exciting — he loves a good run around the yard in the morning to stretch his legs, then he’s perfectly content to relax and recharge. By afternoon, he’s ready again for a walk, a play session, or some quality time with his favourite humans. George is a great traveller, comfortable both inside and outside the home, and he gets along well with other dogs. His easy going nature makes him a wonderful fit for an active family or couple looking for a loyal companion. If you’re ready for a devoted, fun-loving buddy who will bring joy, energy, and plenty of tail wags into your life, George is ready to meet you! 🐶💛

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Are you after a little fire-cracker in your life? Look no further than our boy Ralph! He is all things active/fun-loving and absolutely hilarious; Ralph will have your grinning from ear to ear. Ralph would suit an active family with a backyard who can walk him daily and throw his favourite toy around, Ralph hasn't been exposed to an indoor setting as yet so may take some time adjusting but I think he will happily follow you around. His favourite game is showing his friends how quick his zoomies are so a nice backyard will do the trick so he can show off to you. If you're interested in hearing more about Ralph, please apply now.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Boris is a stunning and gentle boy who can't wait to meet you! Boris is a sweet boy who has learnt lots of things during his time at GAP including being able to walk nicely on lead. He also has a high food drive making him very trainable. Due to his ability to settle alone inside (when in GAP office), in conjunction with crate training to manage toilet training, he can work up to become an inside dog. He is happy to be left independently when you're out at work and would suit full time workers with a backyard or a courtyard ground floor unit. Boris would prefer to be the only pet in the home but has paired well in the past in controlled exposures. An owner who has experience with sight hounds would be the best as he is still learning to be around smaller breeds of dogs. He would suit a home with older children as he is a gentle and respectable and loves a pat. Meet Boris at Western Sydney!

NAME: Tayla
TEXT: 🐾💕 Meet Tayla – Your Gentle, Easy-Going Companion 💕🐾 Tayla is a truly lovely-natured girl with a calm, easy-going personality that makes her a joy to be around. She simply loves being with her people, whether that’s pottering around with you during the day or greeting you happily when you get home. Tayla is a low-energy sweetheart who enjoys life at a relaxed pace. She’ll have the occasional short burst of energy with a little trot around the garden, or she’s just as content enjoying a gentle stroll on the lead. After that, she’s more than happy to settle in and keep you company. She takes everything in her stride - calm around kids, friendly when meeting new people, and always appreciative of pats and attention. Tayla enjoys the presence of other dogs but is equally comfortable doing her own thing. She’s adaptable too, happy being inside or outside as long as she knows her people are nearby. If you’re looking for a wonderful, easy-care companion who will fit beautifully into almost any home, singles, couples, or families, Tayla could be your perfect match.💕🐶

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Stanley is lovely, friendly, soft-natured boy who loves to cuddle. He has a quiet nature and just loves to be around you and check out what you're doing as you go about your day - a sticky beak! He is an easy-going, gentle lad who will be your best friend. Stanley is the perfect gentleman and companion for retirees or workers, he doesn't need much of a walk or trips in the car, he's just happy to hang about at home. Stanley isn’t an energetic boy, very easy-care who would make a wonderful pet, also great with the grandchildren 9 and 13 when they come to visit. 🐾💙

NAME: Winter
TEXT: Brace yourself, WINTER is coming… Like an icy cold beverage on a hot summer’s day, Winter will be the refreshing change you’ve been wanting in your life. Winter might not have any tail but she will show off her excitement by wiggling and bouncing around! Winter is affectionate, confident with a side of zoomies! Despite her name, Winter is anything but cold. Winter will warm your soul with her energetic, goofy & loving personality. Winter is very human social, and would suit teenage kids if she is to be rehomed with children. Though she does love her humans, she is happy to settle on her own for a few hours at a time. She has shown reliable settling in indoor settings. She would suit part-time workers or could build to longer full time hours over time in a quieter suburb with a fun, engaging owner. If in an apartment, Winter would love daily exercise and an active life/outside time. An apartment with lift access is best suited while she is learning staircases. Winter could live with another medium to large doggie friend who doesn't mind her exuberance and excitement levels. Winter is a fun and friendly older girl who would love for you to adopt her! If you’d like the in season greyhound Winter then apply today! She is available now to meet at our Western Sydney site.

NAME: Owen
TEXT: Owen is a sweet-natured and loving boy with a gentle and playful spirit. He loves a run around the backyard and trips to Bunnings as well as relaxing at home, making him the perfect balance of calm and fun. He loves being around people, is good with kids 6+ and has been around Jack Russells and other greyhounds. He's even not been fussed about the pet sheep, chickens or pony! Owen also loves his food! He's very trainable, responding well to treats and praise. He enjoys his walks and is happy to explore or just laze in the backyard. He has been inside with the resident 3 greys and is not concerned about household noises. Owen would make a lovely companion dog or pet inside and out for a couple or family with kids 6+. He is fine on his own for workers and looks forward to your love and attention when you return. 🐾💙

NAME: Piper
TEXT: Meet Piper— your little pocket rocket of joy! 🚀🐶 This sweet, pint-sized girl (only 21kg) is full of life, enthusiasm, and heart. She loves people and especially children to play with. She may greet you excitedly at first, but she is gentle and and doesn’t take long to settle down for cuddles and pats. Yes please! Pint is happiest when she’s by your side - whether it’s heading out for a walk, hopping in the car for an adventure, or snoozing near your desk while you work. She’s housetrained, loves meeting new people and also does well with small dogs (Mini groodle and Kelpie x) and other greys. If you’re looking for a cheerful, affectionate companion who’s ready to join you on life’s adventures, Pint is the perfect match. She would suit an active couple or family who have time to spend with her and nurture her. She's pretty, sweet and flops on the grass to rest when she's had her walk or playtime - you’ll fall in love in an instant! 💛🐾

NAME: Dante
TEXT: Dante is a friendly, calm and affectionate little girl (25kg) who loves people, pats and cuddles and is gentle with kids 6+. She enjoys car rides around town, walks well on lead, loves to play with her soft toys and splash in the her shell pool outside, while also enjoying time inside where she is housetrained and lies in her crate or on her bed, sleeping happily with her legs up in the air, even showering with you! Dante will make a loving family pet or companion, with or without another doggie friend. She is used to other greyhounds and also small dogs (Jack Russell, Pug and Cavoodle) but can spend time on her own. An easy care girl you will fall in love with 💖🐾

NAME: Karen
TEXT: Meet Karen! 🐾 Karen is a bright, bubbly girl with a zest for life that’s impossible not to love. She has a warm, friendly nature and thrives on being part of the family. Always up for an adventure or a game, Karen brings a lovely mix of playful energy and gentle affection. She absolutely adores her people and forms strong bonds, happily soaking up attention and giving plenty of love in return. Whether it’s heading out for some fun in the yard or settling down for a cuddle afterwards, Karen is happiest when she’s included. Karen would ideally love a home with a medium to large dog companion to play with and share adventures. She really enjoys canine company and would thrive with a confident friend by her side. A secure yard to stretch her legs, play, and enjoy the outdoors would be perfect for her. If she were to be the only dog in the home, Karen would need minimal time left alone to begin with while she settles in and builds her confidence. She bonds closely with her humans and loves being part of the action, whether that’s outdoor fun or relaxing together at home. Karen is ready to bring laughter, love, and lots of happy energy into her forever home. And don’t worry — this Karen definitely won’t be asking to speak to your manager… unless it’s to tell them how amazing you are for adopting her! 🐶💕

NAME: Charlie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Charlie is a gentle, friendly greyhound with a heart as big as his long legs. He’s an affectionate boy who absolutely adores being around his people and will happily lean in for cuddles and quiet companionship. If you’re looking for a loyal shadow who enjoys both sofa time and leisurely strolls, Charlie could be your perfect match. Charlie especially loves the company of other greyhounds and would thrive in a home with a calm canine companion. He’s also comfortable around medium to large dogs, making him a wonderful addition to a multi-dog household with similar-sized friends. As he settles into home life, Charlie would benefit from someone who is home more often than not to help him adjust and build confidence. Alternatively, a friendly companion dog to keep him company would help him feel secure and content. Charlie has so much love to give and is ready to find a home where he can relax, feel safe, and be part of the family. If you’re ready to open your heart and home to this sweet, affectionate boy, Charlie is ready to meet you 💙

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has just come back from a foster care home over Christmas — keep reading to find out why his foster carer loved him so much! "Ryan is the most beautiful, special boy with the loveliest and goofy personality that lights up a room. He settled into our home quickly and absolutely loved being around people; happily meeting new faces with his gentle nature. He adores pats and cuddles, often coming up to us for affection and even attempting to lay on top of us just to be close. Ryan is beautifully behaved on the lead and comfortably wears his muzzle, making outings a breeze. He’s a very well-mannered boy who would never jump on benches or steal food, and he patiently waits for his meals like a true gentleman. He loves adventures, from beach trips where he’d happily lay by the waves, to enjoying the rain, playing with boxes/teddies/balls and his favourite sleeping position is sprawled on his back on the couch or floor with his legs in the air without a care in the world. Ryan is such a special soul, and we truly hope he finds the perfect forever home because he deserves all the love and happiness in the world." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan loves his walks around the adoption centre (pictured!) — and did we mention he’s super smart? 🐾 He already knows “on your bed,” “down,” and “shake,” among plenty of other tricks he’s learned in pet training. Ryan’s waiting for his new best friends to pick him up at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre — could that be you?

NAME: Cindy Pawford
TEXT: Cindy Pawford can be shy when she first meets you but she has an affectionate, goofy side! This gorgeous girl has some experience coming inside, and jumping on the couch. She would best suit a home with older/teenage children to see this supermodel thrive. She can be scared of new places/sounds so a home willing to keep things slow at the start would be a good fit. A backyard or townhouse yard with somewhere for her to retreat to will help her find calmness when needed. A home who can show her the joys of pet life as well as bring out her confident side, is going to be the best fit. She can also live alongside another dog after proper introductions. She is young at heart and will thrive into a confident pet once she gets to know you. Available via appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Messi
TEXT: Messi is a confident, excitable and friendly young boy. He would love a home with a yard where he can explore and smell all the interesting things in his new world. He enjoys time with people and would love a home that is willing to share adventures with him and continue teaching him about the best things in life. Messi would be happy to live with another dog who is happy to play and explore but also relax together. He enjoys going out for walks and would love to get some nice treats from a family ready to share their life with him. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Rocco
TEXT: Rocco is a sweet and affectionate gentleman who can be a little shy at first but quickly decides he wants to be your cuddle buddy. He is a gentle middle-aged boy who has spent time with children and other dogs who respectfully shared space with him. Rocco has been getting used to the daily grind, walking in busy park areas meeting people and seeing dogs but he would also love a quiet yard to laze around in the sun. Rocco would be best suited to a canine companion who is quiet and calm like he is and also would prefer to live with calm, older children. He would love someone home to settle him in and spend time with him getting him used to your world and helping him grow his confidence and show his sweet, affectionate nature. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Chumley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Chumley, a happy, social boy who likes to get to know new people and who would thrive in a home with a backyard, with older children. Chumley can live alongside another greyhound or M-L dog and would suit an easy going family who can take all things pet life slow as he learns about the world around him. Chumley has an overall confident, friendly nature and walks nicely on the lead. Chumley has spent some time travelling around with other greyhounds in the same car, so a home who enjoy travelling with their dogs is a good fit for him! Meet our man Chumley by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rusty
TEXT: Meet Rusty, your new best friend! Rusty is a calm and confident middle-aged man who would love a house or townhouse with a yard to enjoy. He would love to relax on the back porch with you watching children play or potentially run around the yard with a new canine companion. Rusty has spent time with children and loves his people so he would prefer to have someone home with him to give all his affection to. Rusty has met some other dogs and enjoys socializing, so he could live with a canine companion who matches his calm nature and enjoys an occasional play. Rusty is ready to make new friends; will you be his new bestie? Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Flo
TEXT: Hi, I'm Flo. I can be shy when I first meet you but I have met children ages 1+ in my past, and done well with polite introductions. A respectful, calm home would suit me the best. A home with a courtyard/yard would be great so I can have some space to explore. I have been polite around big and small dogs and can go home with a likeminded calm canine companion. I've gone on walks out and about and walk very nicely on the lead. A slow introduction to all things pet life will be the best approach as I am still learning. Once you get to know me I become friendly, outgoing and very cuddly! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Hey, It's me, Gus! I am confident and have been around lots of different things before...cars, dams, different surfaces, radios and TV's, all in preparation to meet my forever family! I have gone for walks to the local shops and seen lots of things that make me a confident well rounded dog. I am an excellent traveller and would be a great match for a family who are on the road a bit and want to take their dog with them. I have met people on street walks and enjoy the attention, I would also suit a home with a calm small or large dog. Small dogs seem to like my vibe! My overall energy is calm, friendly with bouts of playfulness guess I am your quintessential greyhound... I hope to meet you soon. Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Marg
TEXT: Marg is an energetic, bubbly young girl who would love a home to zoomie around the yard in and then cuddle up on the couch and be showered in love. She is a confident girl who has had some opportunities to explore the world, and she shows curiosity in new environments. Marg is a social girl who loves people and also has the potential to live with other dogs if their vibes match. She would prefer to have a home with someone who can spend time with her and get her slowly used to spending time alone and she is best suited to living with respectful, older children. Marg's vibrant personality is sure to find her the perfect forever home, would you be the right fit? Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Misty
TEXT: Hi, I'm Misty! I am a sweet girl who will cuddle into your lap. I walk nicely on the lead and will do well on street walks as I have already learnt about them before meeting you! I would be a suitable fit for a home with another dog on the medium to large size. I would love a home with a backyard to call my own and have been around some kids in my past so a home with respectful children isn't out of the question either! I'm still young so a home who enjoys a bubbly dog would be a great fit. I have been called 'fantastic' with children of all ages. How about that!? Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Bindi is a superstar both on and off the track! With 26 wins under her belt, she’s now ready to trade the racetrack for a cozy couch. Confident and affectionate, she adores attention and loves a gentle pat. Bindi is clean, quiet, and travels well in the car. She’s happiest after a good walk, when she can settle down for a well-earned snooze in comfort. This charming girl is looking for a calm, loving home where she can enjoy the best of both adventure and relaxation.

NAME: Barry
TEXT: Barry is a calm and easy-going companion who’s been house-trained and home-raised—he’s never raced and brings a settled, gentle presence to any home. He walks beautifully on lead and enjoys a reassuring pat, making him a joy to have around. Barry gets along well with both small and large dogs, but he does need a cat-free home. His trainer has a preference for domestic re-homing, and with the right patient family, Barry will provide loyal companionship, calm company, and plenty of quiet affection.

NAME: Blake
TEXT: Blake is a sweet, people-focused boy who adores being part of the family. He’s fantastic with children, travels well, and walks beautifully on lead, making every outing a joy. Blake loves affection and happily seeks attention from those around him, thriving on companionship and family life. Social and respectful with both small and large dogs, he would fit seamlessly into a home with other pets or enjoy being the center of attention as the only dog. Blake is ready to share his loving, friendly nature with a family that appreciates his gentle, sociable spirit.

NAME: Luca
TEXT: Luca is a kind and gentle boy with the sweetest nature. He’s wonderful with children, quiet and well-mannered in the car, and polite walking on lead. Luca gets along beautifully with both small and large dogs, making him a lovely companion for a multi-dog household or regular park adventures. He can be a little shy when first meeting new people or exploring new places, but once he feels safe and comfortable, his curious side begins to shine. Luca looks to his people for reassurance and forms strong, trusting bonds with those who show him patience and understanding. In a calm and patient home, Luca will truly blossom—rewarding his family with loyalty, quiet companionship, and plenty of gentle affection.

NAME: Artilla
TEXT: Artilla is an energetic greyhound with a zest for life and a love of adventure. Always ready to get out and explore, he would make a fantastic companion for someone who enjoys staying active and including their dog in everyday outings. This bright boy will thrive as the only dog in the home, where he can soak up all the attention and build a strong bond with his person. With time, patience, and gentle, consistent training, Artilla has all the potential to flourish into an incredibly rewarding companion. He’s looking for a committed owner who’s ready to invest in his development and guide him with kindness and encouragement. In return, Artilla will offer loyalty, enthusiasm, and a whole lot of love. If you’re searching for an adventure buddy and are excited about helping a dog reach his full potential, Artilla could be the perfect match. 💛

NAME: Ice
TEXT: Zeus is a confident and curious greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure. He absolutely loves walks and exploring, taking in all the sights and scents with enthusiasm and interest. Whether it’s a new trail or a familiar neighbourhood stroll, Zeus is happiest when he’s out and about with his people. This handsome boy thrives on human company and truly adores his humans. After a good adventure, he’s more than content to relax by your side, satisfied and happy from a day well spent. Zeus would do best in a single-dog home where he can soak up all the attention and build a strong bond with his family. If you’re looking for a loyal, fun-loving adventure buddy who will share both your journeys and your downtime, Zeus could be your perfect match. 💛

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Bernie is a relaxed and confident greyhound who takes the world in his stride. With his calm outlook and steady nature, he handles new situations with ease and settles in beautifully wherever he goes. He loves exploring his surroundings and is always happy to head out on an adventure, whether it’s discovering a new walking track or simply enjoying a change of scenery. Curious yet composed, Bernie strikes the perfect balance between laid-back companion and enthusiastic explorer. Bernie would be an ideal match for someone looking for a loyal adventure buddy — a best friend who’s just as content out and about as he is unwinding at home afterwards. If you’re ready for a confident, easygoing partner to share life’s journeys, Bernie could be the one for you. 🐾

NAME: Nancy
TEXT: Nancy may be a little shy when you first meet her, but it doesn’t take long for her sweet personality to shine through. With a little reassurance and a gentle approach, she quickly warms up and soon leans in for the pats she secretly loves. Curious and playful, Nancy is a real “Dora the Explorer,” always eager to investigate her surroundings and see what’s going on. Whether she’s sniffing out new scents or checking out a new toy, her inquisitive nature makes every day an adventure. Nancy would truly thrive in a loving, patient home where she can continue to build her confidence, enjoy playful moments, and soak up plenty of affection. With the right family by her side, she’ll blossom into a devoted and joyful companion. 🐾

NAME: Nancy
TEXT: Nancy is a truly affectionate greyhound who simply adores people. A natural people-lover, she thrives on attention and is always eager to please everyone she meets. Her gentle, loving nature makes her an instant favourite with anyone lucky enough to spend time with her. Calm and confident, Nancy takes life in her stride. She enjoys a playful moment when the mood strikes, happily showing off her fun side, but she’s just as content curling up beside her favourite humans for a cuddle and plenty of pats. With her beautiful balance of playfulness and relaxation, Nancy would make a devoted, loving companion for a home ready to share plenty of affection. If you’re looking for a sweet soul who will happily be by your side, Nancy could be the perfect addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a sweet, confident greyhound with a heart as big as his long legs. He absolutely adores people and thrives on human company, happily soaking up every bit of love and attention he can get. Out on walks, Benji is a dream on the lead — calm, graceful, and a pleasure to stroll alongside. He also travels with ease, making him a wonderful companion for adventures near or far. Benji has a missing toe from an old injury, but it doesn’t slow him down one bit. He takes everything in his stride and lives life to the fullest, showing just how resilient and special he is. He would be happiest as the only dog in the home, where he can enjoy being the centre of attention and build a close, devoted bond with his people. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion who will bring warmth and elegance to your home, Benji could be your perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Yola
TEXT: Yola foster update: "So completely house trained it's not funny! Very loving. Loves the car will settle in car straight away sleeps like a log. She loves her walks. She loves people and is such a people dog. Everyone who wants to pat her, she will lap it up! She isn't shy and she is very outgoing. She has never been aggressive to other dogs & has seen quite a few other dogs. She loves people and was super friendly with everyone she met. She will make someone a very loyal loving companion. She sleeps 95% of the day. She has never chewed anything up and loves her toys." ---------------- Yola is affectionate & has the ability to settle for longer periods if you have an apartment with ground floor courtyard access. She doesn't need lots of exercise but if she is indoors all day she'd love to get out and about. A walk once a day is suitable and can settle for 4+ hours on her own sleeping. Yola would thrive best in a low dog-populated area, where she can enjoy peaceful walks. She knows how to use stairs confidently. While Yola can be social with other medium to large dogs, she would prefer to be the only dog in the household, where she can soak up all the love and attention. Her affectionate nature would see her suit to a home with respectful children. Yola is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Loki
TEXT: Straight from Asgard and into your heart: Loki, the God of Mischief is here to bring laughter and joy to your household! But unlike Thor’s brother, this Loki is the good-est boy you’ll ever meet. Loki has learnt many areas of pet life such as being left alone, mastering the stairs and toilet training! He has lived as a pet before and you can tell, he is well adjusted and easy going with his training here. Rather than fighting intergalactic wars, our Loki would rather chill out on his bed and watch the word go by (although he does enjoy the occasional zoomie). Loki prefers to be the only pet of the household and is more than happy to spend the day in his own company making him suitable for full-time workers. He spends most of his time lazing around. He is very affectionate and friendly and will definitely do the "greyhound lean"! His relaxed nature also makes him suitable for living in apartments. If Loki sounds just MARVEL-lous to you, fill out an application to meet him at our Western Sydney facility today!

NAME: Barney
TEXT: If Barney's sweet and soulful eyes have caught your attention, keep reading to find out if you could be the perfect fit for our special guy, Barney. Barney is available to a home who can nurture a shy greyhound out of their shell. Barney requires a special home with a quiet lifestyle and a backyard with secure fencing where he can retreat to and enjoy the peace and quiet away from people when he needs it. A home without children is a must for our shy Barney, however a calm, wise and understanding dog of any size (small or large) would be a lovely companion to help him build his pet skills and help him adapt to his new life with his forever family. If you are someone who can provide a shy dog the structure, support, and ongoing confidence training that he needs to thrive as a pet, we'd love to hear from you. Barney is available for fostering or adoption by discussion with GAP team. We can't wait to hear from Barney's perfect family!

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly is a happy girl with the biggest smile and an even bigger heart. She has a playful, slightly goofy side that will keep you laughing, but at her core she’s a true people-lover who just wants to be near her humans. She’s very people-orientated and thrives on companionship, so a home where someone works from home or where she has another friendly dog to keep her company would suit her beautifully. Tilly is happiest when she’s part of the action and included in family life. Tilly would make a wonderful family dog. She could be workable with a small dog and even a cat, with the right introductions. She walks nicely on lead, enjoys getting out and about, and is very treat motivated — which makes ongoing training both fun and rewarding. She would love a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, play, and soak up the sunshine before coming back inside for cuddles. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, slightly goofy best friend with a permanent smile, Tilly might just be your perfect match. 💛

NAME: Leggy
TEXT: This handsome fellow is currently sharing a yard with another greyhound and spending time playing with a little Italian greyhound. He is very sweet and affectionate, loves to play and loves affection. Would be an excellent supervisor while your working in the yard.

NAME: Barbie
TEXT: This sweet girl looks to suit apartment living given she gets a daily walk and opportunity to stretch out. She has grown up in a semi rural environment around kids, small dog, other greyhounds and the occasional visit from native wildlife.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Luna is an energetic girl that enjoys a yard where she can cut loose in the morning and bust out some zoomies. Then like most greyhounds she's done, finished gone for the day and happy to cuddle up and relax. She shares a yard with Bubba and good left alone.

NAME: Reba
TEXT: Adorable, sweet little Reba is looking for her forever home! Reba recently had a weekend vacation at a staff member's house and she was the perfect house guest! We found that she was a relaxed and super low-maintenance companion, happy to snooze most of the day away in various comfy spots throughout the house. She can be a little nervous and sensitive when she is settling in to a new space and requires gentle handling and does best with a force-free, hands-off approach. However we found that by setting up the environment for success and letting her make decisions, she was the easiest pet ever! When Reba feels comfortable and relaxed, she is super affectionate and loving. She loves to snuggle right into you and is well known for her extremely enthusiastic "paw of more". Reba is completely toilet trained, sleeps well through the night on her bed, eats and engages with training well and can walk up and down stairs! She doesn't mind being left alone inside as long as you are able to slowly work her up to longer hours on her own. She is social and friendly with dogs of all sizes and would gladly share her home with one as long as it is a gentle and relaxed as she is. We think Reba is the perfect pet! If you think so too, apply online to take her home today. She is waiting for you at our Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Jason
TEXT: Meet Jason, a sweet guy with lots of personality, ready to find a place to call home! Jason has spent some time in a home and is ready to step paws into his forever home. A home with a backyard or courtyard would best suit Jason, so he can do his zoomies or have a snooze in the sun. He can be a little shy at first but with a few scratches behind the ear and a couple treats, you'll win him over in no time! A home with quiet children is best suited, so Jason can enjoy the serenity. Jason gets along well with his Greyhound mates, so a home with another medium to large dog could work for him, pending a meet and greet. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Emily
TEXT: Emily is a warm, people-focused gal who has been making lovely progress during her time at GAP. She is bright and responsive, quickly picking up new skills and showing a great willingness to learn. Training sessions are something she genuinely enjoys, especially when food rewards are involved! In new or unfamiliar settings, Emily can be a little reserved at first, but she adjusts quickly once she feels safe and supported. As her confidence grows, her affectionate and engaging personality really shines through. Emily would be best suited as the only pet in the home. She is most comfortable without the presence of other animals and will thrive in an environment where she can relax without needing to share her space. She would be suitable for a home with respectful children. A house with a secure yard would be ideal, giving her room to stretch out and decompress. She is still building confidence with stairs and is progressing steadily, but a home with minimal stairs — or a patient approach while she continues learning — would be beneficial. Initially, Emily would do best in a home where someone is around most of the time, with only short periods of alone time as she transitions. With routine and consistency, her independence can continue to develop. Emily is a clever, affectionate girl who is well on her way to becoming a wonderful companion. In the right home, she will reward her family with loyalty, warmth and steady progress.

NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rex is a people-loving greyhound who thrives on attention and connection. If you’re looking for a companion who enjoys being part of your day and happily soaks up affection, Rex will be right by your side. He’s highly motivated by food, which makes him responsive and engaged, and he settles beautifully in his crate when it’s time to relax. While toys aren’t really his thing, human company certainly is. Rex has socialised well with other greyhounds and could share his home with a compatible medium to large canine friend, though he would be just as happy as the only dog. He would be suitable for a family with respectful children and has shown a calm and affectionate nature in his interactions with people. Rex has demonstrated that he settles best indoors and enjoys the comfort of home life. A townhouse with at least a small courtyard would be ideal, giving him a bit of outdoor space to stretch his legs and unwind. Initially, Rex may be best suited to a home where he has someone home more often than not, while he adjusts, but he has shown an encouraging ability to self-settle. With gradual progression and routine, his capacity can continue to build. Rex is a warm, affectionate boy who is ready to enjoy the comforts of pet life. With structure, guidance and plenty of love, he will make a devoted and rewarding companion.

NAME: Dakota
TEXT: Meet Dakota! Dakota is a beautiful girl with a bright, enthusiastic personality and a whole lot of love to give. She’s full of life and brings a joyful energy to her everyday adventures. Dakota may do well with other dogs of a similar size, especially with thoughtful introductions and continued support. She enjoys interaction and engagement, and her excitable nature means she’s always ready to join in on the fun. Because Dakota can be a bit bouncy when she’s happy, she may be best suited to a home with older children who are comfortable around energetic dogs and can enjoy her playful spirit. Dakota also does quite well while alone and may be suited to a home with full-time workers, given some times to settle in. So, if you’re looking for a happy, lively dog who’s eager to be part of the family, Dakota could be the perfect match. Come meet Dakota at our Londonderry adoption centre!

NAME: Sally
TEXT: This confident and active girl is confident and happy to explore new places with you, she comes when you call her and is a sucker for affection.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Will have a run and stretch out, happy to relax afterwards. Confident and happy girl, comes when called and is a pleasure to be around. Good with kids and seems to like everyone she meets.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Bonnie was breed to be on the couch, she likes to lounge around and keep it real. She is a pretty girl that looks like she would suit the apartment lifestyle.

NAME: Darla
TEXT: This lovely young hound is sweet and affectionate, she could suit apartment lifestyle given that she gets some daily steps in outside.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear 🐻 Bear is a calm, friendly, and affectionate senior gentleman with a heart as big as his name. This sweet boy absolutely loves pats, cuddles, and soaking up attention, whether at home or greeting new people on his walks or travels. Bear is wonderful with children aged 5-10 and enjoys playing “chasies” in the yard before settling down for a well-earned rest. He also gets along beautifully with small dogs and other greyhounds, making him a lovely addition to a multi-dog home. An easy-care kind of guy, Bear has short bursts of energy and enjoys his daily walks, but he’s just as content resting and watching the world go by. He’s the perfect balance of playful and peaceful. If you’re looking for a gentle family pet or a devoted companion to share quiet moments and cozy cuddles, Bear is ready to fill your home with warmth and love. 🐾💛

NAME: Cheesey
TEXT: Meet Cheesey – Your Loyal, Lovable Sidekick 🐾 Cheesey is a lovely-natured boy with a gentle, caring heart. He absolutely adores kids aged 10–13 and thrives on attention, pats, and plenty of love. When you come home, he’ll greet you with happy excitement, then quickly settle down after pats and play, content just to be by your side. On walks, Cheesey is a dream - once he get sgoing he happily strolls at your pace and enjoys taking in the world with you. After a nice walk and a zoom around the yard or some fun with his toys, he’s more than ready to flop on the floor for a well-earned rest. He’s attentive, loyal, and eager to please, making him a very trainable companion. Cheesey loves splashing in his water bowl or cooling off in a shell pool — he’s got a playful streak and a bit of a cheeky character that will keep you smiling. Importantly, Cheesey is also wonderfully patient and independent. He’s perfectly happy to relax on his own during the day if you’re at work - no fuss, no hassle. Just a steady, easygoing boy waiting for his people to come home. 🐾💙

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful active boy who loves to go on adventures max is suited to full time workers max loves older kids as he loves to play with toys and can sometimes forget his size with younger children. despite his energy max walks very well on lead max requires a larger fenced area to ensure he stays in the backyard all day as he can sometimes want to go and hang out around the neighbourhood. max is a clean and healthy boy and would suit your more active lifestyle

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a beautifully social girl who absolutely adores people. She is warm, engaging and thrives on human connection, happily seeking out pats, interaction and companionship. She shows lovely manners when meeting new people and would likely do very well in a home with respectful children who understand gentle dog interactions. She appears most comfortable as the only dog in the household, where she can relax and not feel the need to share her space. Molly is not suited to living with cats or multi-dog households. Indoors, Molly settles nicely and maintains good house manners, including keeping her space clean. She could live in an apartment, provided her new home is mindful of her needs. At this stage, she finds extended periods of alone time difficult and prefers having her people nearby. A home where someone is around for much of the day, or where time alone can be built up gradually and positively, will help her feel secure. Molly is a devoted, affectionate companion who bonds deeply with her humans. In a home where she can be the centre of attention and enjoy plenty of companionship, she will truly shine.

NAME: Dot
TEXT: Meet Dot (Romantic Lily), a 4‑year‑old female greyhound joining us at the Valentine’s Day adoption event. Dot is a gentle, steady girl who is beginning to settle well into home life. She enjoys exploring, relaxing with her people, and she absolutely loves the water. Dot gets on well with all dogs and has a calm, social nature that makes her easy to have around. She’s learning the rhythm of household living and is taking everything in her stride. With her sweet temperament and easygoing personality, Dot is ready to find a home where she can continue to grow in confidence. If you’re looking for a loving companion to share your heart and home, Dot might be the perfect Valentine match.

NAME: Maizie
TEXT: Meet Maizie 🐾💖 Maizie is a lively, playful greyhound bursting with energy and personality! She’d thrive in a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, zoom to her heart’s content, and enjoy the great outdoors. A confident canine companion would be the perfect match for Maizie – she loves the company of other dogs and enjoys having a buddy by her side. With her fun-loving nature, Maizie is best suited to a home with older children who can keep up with her zest for life. She absolutely lives for treats, adores affection, and isn’t shy about handing out face licks as her signature love language! If you’re looking for a smart, affectionate greyhound who’s full of beans and full of love, Maizie is ready to join your family and brighten your days (and maybe even steal your heart…)

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope, a sweet and gentle soul who's ready to bring warmth and companionship into your life. Her quiet nature is truly heartwarming, making her an ideal companion for anyone seeking a serene presence. Hope is crate trained, offering peace of mind when you need it. Her adaptable nature enables her to live comfortably in a variety of environments, from small apartments to more spacious homes. Hope is a social butterfly when it comes to her fellow canines. Whether large or small, she gets along famously with dogs of all sizes. If you're looking for a sweet, quiet, and gentle companion, Hope is sure to become a beloved member of your family.

NAME: Amber
TEXT: *Amber has just gone to foster care!* Amber is 11 years young and every bit the sweetheart you hope for in a senior greyhound. She has completely charmed our team and quickly settle into living in the office here at GAP. If there’s a soft spot in the room and a friendly human nearby, that’s exactly where you’ll find her. Since joining us, Amber has been spending her days stretched out in our office, peacefully snoozing while staff work around her. She has transitioned beautifully into an indoor routine — no accidents, settles with ease overnight, and remains relaxed when left on her own. She truly understands the art of quiet companionship. Amber is deeply affectionate in the loveliest, most gentle way. She adores being near her people, enjoys soft pats, and is happiest in calm, steady company. At this stage of her life, she’s not looking for adventure — she’s looking for comfort. A low-key home where she can lounge, nap, and simply be part of the family would be perfect. Because she’s a mature lady, a ground-floor home or apartment with lift access would be ideal, as daily stairs wouldn’t suit her long-term comfort. She could happily share her home with another relaxed greyhound, but she would prefer to avoid small, busy breeds. Amber could suit a family, provided children understand how to respect a dog’s space and enjoy a gentle, slower-paced companion. She is the definition of an “old soul” — soft, loving, and ready to spend her days with her people close by. If you’ve been searching for a calm, devoted companion to share quiet moments and warm cuddles, Amber might just be the one.

NAME: Wendall
TEXT: Wendall is at the beginning of his pet life and, after recently settling into the kennels, he has shown us he is very much a gentle giant. As he transitions into this new stage, he is being introduced to everyday routines, handling and domestic-style experiences at a pace that allows him to build understanding and confidence. We have noticed that Wendall prefers having his people nearby and appears most comfortable when he has human company. He generally gets along well with other greyhounds and may suit a home with another compatible canine companion, pending a meet and greet. At this stage, Wendall appears more settled outdoors than indoors, suggesting he may appreciate a home with access to a secure yard while he continues adjusting to household living. Like many greyhounds early in their retirement, he will benefit from a family willing to guide him through the transition from kennel routine to home life with patience and consistency. Despite his size, Wendall has lovely moments of calm and gentle interaction, and he could suit a family with children who understand how to respectfully interact with dogs. As he continues gaining exposure and experience, we expect his confidence within the home environment to keep developing. If you are ready to support Wendall as he navigates this exciting next stage, he may be the perfect addition to your home. Enquire now.

NAME: Minnie
TEXT: *Minnie is in a foster care home* Minnie is a sweet, bubbly girl. Minnie is friendly, affectionate, a tad goofy, and oh so lovable! Minnie is a great blend of silly and calm, being middle aged she's ready to kick off her lounge lizard era, and can't wait to meet you! A home with a yard to perfect her zoomies, and some children to entertain her after school, would be a great fit. In return Minnie promises to keep everyone upbeat and having fun every day. She can be nervous in new places so a family who are happy to take it slow to begin with would be a great fit. This gorgeous girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is the sweetest, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home, though he can be on his own or with another dog to play with. 💙

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Adorable, playful boy Ocean is looking for a new place to call home! Ocean is an outgoing and friendly boy best known for his goofy, playful bursts that will have you laughing! At 6-years-old, Ocean is a little more relaxed and those playful spurts don't last long before he needs a good recharge nap, making him an easy pet! Ocean is pretty easy-going and doesn't mind spending a few hours alone while his humans are away, provided you live in a quieter neighbourhood without too much hustle and bustle going on beyond the fence. Ocean gets along well with other medium-large dogs and is also suitable for living with older, respectful children. We just know Ocean is going to bring his forever family so much love and joy! He is waiting for you at our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Toby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Happy and handsome blue boy Toby is a friendly, confident and social boy who loves to recieve praise and treats. He would suit a home with a home with some hours alone during the day, and can live alongside another greyhound. He has also become friends with a Labrador! An owner willing to continue his training around smaller breeds of dogs will see Toby succeed as he would benefit from ongoing exposure. He can walk up and down stairs and would love a backyard to call his own, however he settles best in indoor settings. A family who will include him in the daily activities of family life will be a great fit. Older/teen kids would be the best match for his occasionally bouncy nature. Meet Toby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Lilo
TEXT: Lilo loves to feel the earth under her feet and be in the yard but she does also like affection and being close the ones she loves. She likes the water and cooling down on hot days. She will inspect new people she meets and will come around once she approves.

NAME: Stitch
TEXT: Stitch has lived around farm animals and native animals most of her life so she is unbothered by a lot of things. She may get excited but she calms down quite quickly. She is very confident and happy and would love a yard to look after.

NAME: Rapunzel
TEXT: Rapunzel loves any form of affection. She will come to you when called, she is confident and not bothered by much in life.

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: Lulu isn't bothered by the sheep and native animals that surround her. She is a happy go lucky girl that is very confident and ready to explore new places.

NAME: Flick
TEXT: This lovely girl needs time to warm to you, she does have a nervous and cautious nature with new people. She warms to you very quickly and is extremely pleasant and polite to be around. She likes toys and is easy to walk on the lead.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a confident friendly boy who is great company. He loves to play, loves affection and walks well on the lead. Benji loves the water and going for a swim. Benji has had experience in the home and likes to keep you company. He is an excellent companion who needs a thunder buddy since he is not a fan of storms.

NAME: Geno
TEXT: Meet Geno, a sweet and happy boy who's sure to steal your heart with his wagging tail and bright eyes, as he loves nothing more than receiving pats from everyone he meets. Geno is a sociable pup who revels in the company of other dogs. His friendly demeanor means he'll quickly become a beloved member of any dog-friendly household. He's a fan of good meals and thoroughly enjoys his food. One of Geno's most endearing qualities is his love for the water. Geno loves to splash in his paddle pool and Geno is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a mix of play and relaxation. If you're looking for a sweet, happy dog who's as charming as he is friendly, Geno could be the perfect match for you. With Geno, every day is an opportunity for fun, affection, and shared experiences.

NAME: Dex
TEXT: Meet Dex, the strikingly handsome and robust canine companion who loves for water and has a zest for life, Dex is the ideal pet for those who appreciate an adventurous soul . Dex exudes strength and charm, preferring the company of larger dogs who match his playful energy and enthusiasm. Whether he's splashing around in a pool, pond, or simply enjoying a sunny day outdoors, Dex is happiest when he's with his big-sized friends. Toys are another passion of Dex's; he enjoys the simple pleasures of tug-of-war or a good game of fetch. His playful antics with his toys will surely keep you entertained. While he adores the companionship of big dogs, he prefers a home without small dogs to ensure everyone's comfort and harmony. Dex's energetic nature would thrive in a home with an active lifestyle, spacious yard, or access to dog-friendly outings. Embrace the adventure and heartwarming fun that Dex brings to every day. Are you ready to welcome a strong, water-loving, toy-enthusiast into your life.

NAME: Ricky
TEXT: Ricky is a calm, affectionate greyhound who is still learning the ropes of pet life and taking it all in stride. He has a gentle, easygoing presence and enjoys being close to his people, especially when affection and praise are involved. He’s the kind of dog who thrives on positive attention and is keen to please once he understands what’s being asked of him. Ricky is currently building his basic life skills and responding well to training, particularly when it’s delivered with encouragement, praise, and calm guidance. As his confidence and understanding grow, so does his ability to settle, making him a good candidate for a home with full-time workers once he’s had time to adjust and learn how to relax independently. He would benefit from a home with access to a backyard, where he can move freely, decompress, and enjoy some quiet outdoor time. While Ricky may enjoy the company of another greyhound or a medium to large dog, he can be a little socially awkward when initiating play. Because of this, any canine companion should be tolerant, steady, and happy to set gentle boundaries. Ricky is looking for a home that understands he’s still learning and is happy to guide him through this next chapter with patience and kindness. With the right support, he has all the makings of a relaxed, affectionate companion who will settle beautifully into family life and enjoy the simple pleasures of being a pet.

NAME: Bridget
TEXT: *Bridget has just gone into a foster care home - check in soon for updates!* Hey guys! In my first week in foster, I have now mastered the stairs and am enjoying the yummy treats and extra cuddles. I enjoy exploring the house and watching my new human friends go about their daily lives. I get excited for my dinner and do a little prance which has delighted my new friends. I have made myself comfortable on the lounges and I have been enjoying some alone time already being solo for three hours just relaxing on the sofa on the deck. Bridget is a sweet girl who steals your heart after opening up. She would suit a quiet household without children or a busy social lifestyle. Bridget is very much a homebody who enjoys lounging and taking life at a slower pace. While she may be able to live with a medium to large dog, any companion would need to be particularly tolerant and socially steady, as Bridget can become a little socially clumsy when she’s feeling playful or unsure. Even so, her greatest comfort comes from her relationship with her people. Neck scratches are her love language and once you win her over and she'll be endlessly entertaining you with her playful antics. As you inevitably fall in love with one another, her gentle demeaner will give way to a more quirky side. Pairing that iconic greyhound charm with her own unique twist. Solidified in your bond, she will lean on your confidence in her to navigate the unfamiliar world. A home that is willing to support her as she adjusts to her new lifestyle is ideal. New friends are on the horizon of your patience and compassion, revealing to her joy in previous uncertainties. A journey you and her will never forget.

NAME: Cheeky
TEXT: Cheeky is a joyful, energetic girl whose name says it all! She’s bursting with personality, always ready for an adventure, and guaranteed to bring a smile to your face. Cheeky has a playful, spirited nature. Whether she’s zooming around the yard, exploring new places, or showing off her silly side, she brings excitement and joy to every day. She thrives on activity and engagement, perfect for someone who enjoys a lively companion. Her zest for life is contagious! Despite all her energy, Cheeky has a beautifully soft side. She’s incredibly affectionate and loves being close to her humans, soaking up cuddles and attention whenever she can.

NAME: Asha
TEXT: Asha is a sweet and loyal greyhound with a gentle personality and a heart big enough for everyone she meets. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate companion and playful friend. 💛 Sweet & Loyal Asha bonds deeply with her people and loves being part of the action. Whether she’s leaning in for cuddles or trotting happily beside you, she’s all about love and connection. 🐶 Great With Other Dogs One of her standout traits is how beautifully she gets along with other dogs. She’s friendly, social, and thrives in the company of canine buddies. ✨ Why You’ll Love Asha Sweet, gentle, and people‑focused Fun-loving with a soft, joyful personality Gets along wonderfully with other dogs Loyal and affectionate

NAME: Kota
TEXT: 🌸 Meet Kota - A Gentle Soul Looking for a Patient, Loving Home Kota is a very special girl with a soft heart and a sensitive spirit. She may take a little while to warm up, but once she trusts you, she forms deep, meaningful bonds that make every moment worth the wait. 💗 A Sensitive, Quiet Beauty Kota can feel a bit unsure in new environments, and she prefers to take things slowly. She’s not the kind of dog who rushes into new situations, she observes, thinks, and opens up at her own pace. But beneath that initial shyness is a truly affectionate, loyal companion. 🏡 Needs a Calm, Patient Home Kota will thrive in a warm, gentle, and patient household where she can feel safe and loved. She’ll do best with people who understand that trust takes time, and who are happy to give her the space and reassurance she needs to blossom.

NAME: Wally
TEXT: Wally is bursting with life, personality, and joy. He’s the kind of dog who can make you smile just by walking into the room, a true spirit-lifter with a heart of gold. 😄 Goofy & Full of Life Wally is delightfully silly in all the best ways. He loves to play, explore, and make his humans laugh with his quirky antics. 💛 Loves People This boy is a social butterfly. Wally absolutely adores people, he greets everyone like a long‑lost friend and thrives on attention, pats, and companionship. He’s happiest when he’s included in whatever you’re doing. 🐶 Fantastic With Other Dogs Wally is also great with other dogs, bringing a friendly, upbeat energy to every doggy interaction. He’s the kind of dog who gets the whole group wagging.

NAME: Target
TEXT: 🎯 Meet Target — The Sweet, Loyal Greyhound With the Cutest Dot! Target is a friendly and loyal boy whose unique little dot on his head inspired his name. One look at him, and you’ll understand why it’s impossible not to fall in love.. ✨ Personality Target is the definition of sweet-natured. He’s calm, affectionate, and incredibly people‑oriented. Whether he’s leaning in for cuddles or quietly following you from room to room, he loves being close to his humans. 🐶 Great With Other Dogs This handsome boy has beautiful social manners. He’s relaxed, polite, and friendly around other dogs, making him a great fit for multi-dog households or families who enjoy dog-friendly outings. 🚶‍♂️ Gentle on the Lead Walks with Target are a dream. He’s light, steady, and easy to guide, making him an ideal walking companion even for those who prefer a more relaxed pace.

NAME: Xavier
TEXT: This sweet, playful boy is the perfect mix of goofy charm and gentle affection. ✨ Personality Xavier is a naturally happy, social, and easygoing soul. He loves to play, whether that’s zoomies in the yard, tossing a toy in the air, or doing his best “wiggle dance” when he’s excited. But when playtime’s over, he’s just as happy to curl up beside you for pats. 🐶 Great with Other Dogs One of Xavier’s standout qualities is how wonderfully he gets along with other dogs. He’s polite, friendly, and enjoys having canine companions around. Whether your household is full of doggy friends or you visit dog parks regularly, Xavier will fit right in. 💖 What Makes Him Special Sweet, soft-natured, and affectionate Very playful but not overwhelming Beautiful brindle coat with a charming personality to match Excellent social manners with other dogs If you’re looking for a loving, gentle, and joyful greyhound to brighten your days, Xavier might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Cheeky
TEXT: 💖 Meet Cheeky – Your Loyal, Low‑Maintenance Best Girl Cheeky is a sweet, loyal girl who lives up to her name with just the right amount of charm. At four years old, she’s mature, settled, and wonderfully low‑maintenance—perfect for someone wanting an easy, affectionate companion. Cheeky is deeply loyal and loves nothing more than being close to her person. She’s gentle, calm, and happy simply sharing your space—whether that’s lounging on the couch, strolling beside you on a walk, or keeping you company at home. While Cheeky is polite and friendly with other dogs out and about, she can get a little jealous when sharing her home with other animals. Because she bonds so strongly, she’d prefer a home where she can soak up all the love and attention as your only girl. Cheeky would thrive with someone looking for: A low‑maintenance, calm companion A loyal dog who prefers a quiet, stable environment A pet‑free household where she can shine as the centre of attention ❤️ Why You’ll Love Her Cheeky is affectionate without being demanding, loyal without being clingy, and charming in a subtle, endearing way. She’s the kind of dog who fits seamlessly into your routine and becomes that steady, comforting presence in your home.

NAME: Arlo
TEXT: Arlo is an affectionate boy with a beautiful brindle coat. He’s a soft, social soul who adores being around people and thrives on gentle attention. At almost two years old, he’s in that perfect stage—playful and curious but already calm and well‑mannered. This sweet boy has a patient, gentle nature that makes him well-suited to families with children. He enjoys being involved in family life and loves soaking up pats, ear scratches, and cuddles from little humans. He also loves to play with other medium to large dogs. 🏡 Ideal Home Arlo would thrive in a home that: Enjoys daily walks, playtime, and plenty of affection Understands the needs of a young greyhound—soft beds, gentle routines, and occasional goofy antics ❤️ Why You’ll Love Him Arlo is all heart. He’s the kind of dog who bonds deeply, follows you with those big soulful eyes. Whether he’s snoozing in the sun, trotting happily beside a dog buddy, or leaning in for a cuddle, Arlo brings warmth and joy everywhere he goes.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Hi, I'm Bonnie. I get along nicely with other dogs including my chihuahua friend I get along with (pictured), making me a great fit for a home with smaller dogs. A home without kids would be best as I can be nervous with too much going on. A quiet, chilled out home would be my best fit as I would like some peace and quiet, this will help me feel confident and thrive in your environment. If you have a chilled out home and another dog for me to be friends with, get in touch with the GAP team to meet me! You can meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ray
TEXT: Hey, I'm Ray! You could say I am a ray of sunshine, I'm so friendly and vibrant and ready to light up your life! 🔆 I will give you cuddles, licks and give you an amazing first impression with my confident personality. My best suited home is a home who loves all things greyhounds - from my zoomies to my naps. I love zoomies and play, and I will be your sweet and joyful companion who will always be wiggly and cute when you get home from work. I will run around and keep you active, so a home with a yard is going to be great for me and my sunshine personality! I can be excited to get going on the lead but I will be eager to learn and walk nicely once we get into routine. My best suited home is one with shorter hours alone while I settle in, I can also go home with a medium to large canine companion. If you need some more rays of sunshine in your life, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Trigg
TEXT: Trigg is a sweet and friendly boy with a gentle, soft soul. He’s happy to potter around independently and is comfortable spending time on his own in the yard, but he also truly enjoys human company and settles easily when indoors or alongside his people. Trigg is great on lead and a pleasure to walk. He does well with large dogs and other greyhounds, and while he can be a little shy when first meeting new or smaller dogs, he warms up with time and gentle introductions. With his calm nature and easygoing personality, Trigg would suit a relaxed home looking for a loving and low-key companion.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a friendly and confident boy who genuinely enjoys human interaction and being part of the family. He’s comfortable travelling and is happy to join you on outings, making him a great companion for an on-the-go lifestyle. Jack is best suited to a home with other large dogs or greyhounds and would not be suitable for homes with small dogs or birds. On lead, he can be a little excitable at first, but once given clear direction he settles quickly and walks along nicely. With guidance, consistency, and plenty of affection, Jack will make a loyal and engaging addition to the right home.

NAME: Erroll
TEXT: Erroll is a confident, playful boy who loves engaging with both people and other dogs. Full of energy and boisterous fun, he thrives on walks, playtime, and being right in the middle of the action. Whether it’s heading out for an adventure or joining in on social time, Erroll is always keen to be involved. Despite his lively nature, Erroll is also able to settle comfortably, making him a great balance of fun and companionship. He’d suit a home that can keep up with his enthusiasm and enjoy sharing life with a dog who brings joy, confidence, and plenty of personality.

NAME: Lionel
TEXT: Lionel is a confident and friendly boy who absolutely loves people and greets life with a curious, playful spirit. Well-behaved and affectionate, he enjoys being involved in whatever’s going on around him and would suit an active, loving home where he can share daily walks and quality time. Lionel is happiest when he’s with his best buddy Hazel, and the two share a special bond. If you’re able to welcome them both, you’ll be rewarded with a perfectly matched pair who bring companionship, fun, and plenty of heart into the home.

NAME: Hazel
TEXT: Hazel is a beautiful blue female greyhound with a calm, confident, and sweet-natured personality. She loves attention and will happily respond when you call her name, always ready for a gentle pat or some quiet company. Hazel gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a home that offers a yard and regular companionship. She shares a special bond with her friend Lionel, and if you have room in your heart and home for two, Hazel would absolutely love to stay by his side. With her gentle presence and loving nature, Hazel would make a wonderful, loyal companion.

NAME: Rodney
TEXT: Rodney is a stunning black male greyhound with a shiny coat and a full-of-beans personality to match. He’s an excitable, playful boy who brings joyful energy wherever he goes, but don’t let that fool you—he absolutely melts for pats and affection. Rodney would thrive in a home that enjoys daily walks and a bit of fun, as he loves getting out and about and stretching his long legs. He enjoys the company of other larger breed dogs and is happy to share his space, but he’s just as content soaking up someone’s full attention and being the star of the show. With his playful spirit and loving nature, Rodney is the kind of dog who will keep you smiling and fill your home with warmth (and the occasional zoomie). If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart, Rodney might just be your perfect match 💛

NAME: Billy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hey, Billy here! I'm a cheerful & sweet guy with a gentle nature. I walk nicely on the lead and promise to go on a laid back dawdle around the block peacefully with you. Because I am gentle and loving, I'm also polite around big and small dogs on walks and can go home with another medium to large breed canine companion. A home with respectful children would be suitable for me. I am a good traveller in the car, and have no issue around things like lawnmowers, vans, foot traffic on walkies, etc and would be the kind of dog to take things in my stride! A home with a yard or a small courtyard would be great so I have somewhere to chill out when I want to. Come meet me at Western Sydney by appointment!

NAME: Fred
TEXT: *Fred is in a foster care home and is available to adopt* Meet Fred! Fred is a gorgeous greyhound with a gentle soul, a big heart for people, and an even bigger love for snacks. He’s the kind of dog who could right into your home life! Fred is comfortable sleeping in his crate and settles in like a pro, making bedtime a breeze. He’s also okay being left alone for reasonable periods, so he may be able to handle a normal workday or errands while he stays home. Independent and affectionate? That’s a great combo. When it comes to people, Fred is all in. He loves human company and enjoys soaking up attention, whether that’s quiet companionship or a few well-earned pats. Fred is very food-motivated, which makes him super trainable and eager to learn. Treats are the way to his heart, and he’s happy to work for them. Fred would do wonderfully in a home looking for a calm, loving dog who already has some great life skills and is ready to keep learning. If you’re looking for a sweet, people-loving greyhound who’s as smart as he is charming, Fred might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Scoot
TEXT: Scoot is a gentle and kind boy, well mannered with a really lovely temperament. He will wait his turn and is patient around other greys and little dogs including a mini poodle, Shih Tzus and a Pug. Scoot is happy, friendly, fun-loving and an easy going all-rounder. He's loves a bit of a zoomie in the morning and a walk in the afternoon or a play in the yard, a splash in his shell pool, but just as happy to flop down on the floor and chill out. Scoot will laze about watching or follow you around as you go about your daily chores; he likes to check out what you're doing whether that's gardening, being in the shed, going for a walk or off to feed the chickens before dinner and bedtime. He gets along with other dogs, and household kids 10 and 14 but its in his nature to be gentle with younger kids 5+ as well. Scoot Scoot would make a loving loyal companion or family pet who just wants to be your best friend. 💙

NAME: Lily
TEXT: Lily is a sensitive, nervous girl who’s looking for a patient and loving home where she can continue to build her confidence at her own pace. She’s currently working on exposure in a home environment and is making progress with calm, supportive guidance. Lily has been around small dogs, though she’ll need slow, safe introductions and careful management as she settles in. A quiet household with understanding humans who are happy to let her take things one step at a time would suit her best. With kindness, consistency, and a little extra love, Lily has the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion.

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby is a very energetic greyhound who’s always ready to go. She’s best suited to an active lifestyle with plenty of opportunities to burn off her energy and enjoy structured play. If Shelby is rehomed with another dog, she’ll need an experienced owner and a canine companion who can truly match her energetic play style. She plays hard and would do best with a confident, compatible dog who enjoys the same level of activity. A secure backyard is a must for Shelby, giving her the space she needs to run, play, and unwind. In the right home, Shelby will thrive as a fun, lively companion for someone who loves an active dog.

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Lenny is a beautiful male greyhound who knows exactly what he likes—and he likes his own space. He’d be happiest as a solo dog, where he can fully relax and enjoy being the center of attention. Out and about, Lenny is perfectly fine around other dogs and handles public settings well, but he’s not a fan of other dogs getting too close in his personal bubble. Because of this, he’s best suited to a home where he can have his space respected. Lenny would thrive in a semi-active household and is accustomed to being handled by kids, making him a great option for a family that understands dog boundaries. He’s a lovely boy with lots to offer the right home.

NAME: Roger
TEXT: Roger is a handsome black greyhound with a calm, easygoing vibe. He’s a pretty chill dude who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and doesn’t ask for much beyond comfort, kindness, and a good routine. Roger would do best as a solo dog or with a female canine companion. He can be workable with small dogs and even cats, given the right introductions and management. His laid-back nature makes him a great match for full-time workers or a family looking for a low-key, affectionate dog. If you’re after a gentle, uncomplicated companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roger might just be your guy.

NAME: Mickey
TEXT: Mickey is a gorgeous white and blue male greyhound with a truly lovely personality — and he’s a smaller boy too, which just adds to his charm. He’s sweet, gentle, and a pleasure to have around. Mickey has spent time in a house and is comfortable being indoors, though he hasn’t lived full-time inside yet. He can manage stairs going up, but will need some support and patience with coming back down as he continues learning. He is workable with small dogs and, with the right slow and careful introductions, may also be cat workable. His future family will need to be prepared to put in the time and consistency to help him succeed, but Mickey’s kind nature makes him well worth the effort.

NAME: Fang
TEXT: Fang is a striking white and red brindle male greyhound with a gentle, sensitive nature. He walks nicely on lead and enjoys getting out for calm, relaxed strolls. When first meeting new people, Fang can be a little nervous and appreciates a slow, patient approach. He will come over for pats, but prefers things to be taken at his pace — once he feels safe, he settles beautifully and shows his sweet, trusting side. Fang had a calm interaction with a small dog, enjoying a polite sniff before disengaging, and he showed lovely manners around other greyhounds during his assessment. He would do best in a home that understands shy dogs and is happy to let him build confidence in his own time.

NAME: Precious
TEXT: Precious is a beautiful black female greyhound with a calm, thoughtful nature and a quiet charm. She travels well, making her an easy companion for outings or trips, and settles nicely when on the move. Precious enjoys affection on her own terms and will happily engage for pats when she’s in the mood, showing her gentle and endearing personality. She gets along wonderfully with other greyhounds and is workable with small dogs, especially with sensible introductions and guidance. She would suit a home that appreciates a dog who is affectionate yet independent, and who values relaxed companionship over constant attention. Precious at a glance: Black female greyhound Travels well Enjoys pats when interested Great with other greyhounds Workable with small dogs Precious is a lovely girl who brings a calm presence and quiet warmth to those lucky enough to spend time with her 🐾🖤

NAME: Tully
TEXT: Tully is a stunning black female greyhound with a gentle soul and a soft, affectionate nature. She can be a little shy when she first meets new people, but give her a moment (and a bit of patience) and she quickly warms up into a loving, pat-seeking companion. Tully is social with small dogs and has had a few calm, positive introductions with cats, showing polite curiosity. She enjoys getting out and about and walks beautifully on lead, making her a lovely partner for relaxed strolls. Once she feels comfortable, Tully really shines — she adores pats, quiet companionship, and being near her people. She would thrive in a calm home that’s happy to let her settle in at her own pace and watch her confidence blossom.

NAME: Marshall
TEXT: *Marshall has spent time in a foster care home over Christmas!* Marshall is a lovable guy who’s happiest when he’s right by your side,he’ll follow you around like your own little shadow, eager to be involved in all your daily adventures. He’d do best in a home where someone’s around more often then not to help him settled into pet life. Marshall also needs a yard to roam and explore since settling inside can be a bit tricky for him,though he does have a soft spot for his crate, which he finds cosy and calming. He’s great with kids 10 and up, and while he’s okay with medium to large dogs when out and about, he really prefers being the star of the show at home,so a single-dog household would be his dream come true.
