She is polite around other dogs, someone who is home more often than not to help nurture Kay into a beloved family member will be the best fit for Kay. Meet our lovely Kay at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: If you're looking for a playful, engaged dog who is polite with other dogs and who would enjoy an active, fun life, consider adopting Rocky. Rocky is a friendly brindle boy who has experience with kids 12+. He loves a scratch behind the ear and has a confident, outgoing nature. He is a social butterfly and would enjoy being a part of family activities whether that's walks to school or going to the park. He can be excited to get going on walks so an owner who can handle a strong dog is recommended. Rocky is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stella
TEXT: Meet Stella🌟 Say hello to Stella, a gorgeous greyhound with a heart as big as her smile! This social butterfly absolutely adores her canine friends and loves nothing more than a good play session with her doggy pals. Stella isn’t fazed by much — she takes everything in her stride with her calm, easy-going nature. Whether she’s out on an adventure or lounging at home, Stella is simply happy to be part of the fun. She’s a big fan of her humans too! Pats, ear rubs, and cuddles are always on her wish list, and she’ll happily follow you around or curl up at your feet once playtime is over. When she’s not making friends, Stella enjoys playing with her toys or just relaxing in a comfy spot nearby. With her affectionate personality and playful charm, she’s the perfect all-round companion. Stella’s dream home is one where she can share her days with loving humans (and maybe a furry friend or two) who will give her the love and attention she so happily returns.

NAME: Vern
TEXT: Vern is a gentleman who walks nicely on the lead, who is confident and happy around new people and happy to go gentle walks around the block everyday. A fenced backyard and a home who will include him in daily activities would be a great fit for him. Vern has a positive and welcoming nature which would see him suit a family with children. Meet Vern by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Billy! I'm a handsome fawn boy looking to find my perfect forever home. He is happy exploring new places and would enjoy a home with a fenced yard to call his own. He would love to be included in daily adventures like walks to and from the school pick up or spending time at the park! Billy is suitable to live with other dogs after a meet and greet. You can meet Billy at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: This handsome boy is a high energy, loving guy looking to bounce into your home. He loves a pat and a bit of attention but is also happy to do his own thing. He has a charming and personable nature who we think would get along well with children and other dogs. Meet Hank by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Affectionate boy Teddy is a sweet boy who walks gently on the lead and will greet you with a gentle tail wag. He is a calm, loving and sooky boy looking for someone to dote on him. He's easy to walk and has an easy going nature. He is friendly around other greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog. This cutie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddie🚗 Say hello to Freddie, a happy, friendly greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure! This handsome boy is the perfect mix of laid-back and enthusiastic — he loves meeting new people, exploring new places, and, most of all, hopping in the car for a good old-fashioned road trip. Freddie is an absolute star traveller. Whether it’s a quick ride around town or a longer journey, he settles in beautifully and enjoys watching the world go by from the back seat. He’s the ultimate co-pilot, always up for an outing and never one to say no to an adventure. When it comes to socialising, Freddie’s as easy-going as they come. He’s very friendly and happy when meeting new people — tail wagging, big smiles, and all the charm you could ask for. He also gets along wonderfully with medium and large dogs, enjoying their company and a good bit of canine social time. And if there’s one thing Freddie truly loves (besides travel and friends), it’s food! He’s wonderfully food-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze — and ensures he’s always ready for a tasty treat or two. Freddie would suit a home that enjoys getting out and about, but he’s just as content relaxing after a day’s adventure. With his friendly personality, love for life, and easy-going nature, Freddie is sure to make every day feel like a road trip worth taking.

NAME: Bull
TEXT: Bull is a nice boy who loves, playing, loves affection, is good on the lead. He likes meeting new people and new critters on his walks and is very social and outgoing with great character. He has been getting experience coming inside. There something about Bull that you will love.

NAME: Tiny
TEXT: Tiny is a quiet little girl who is very sweet & often shy with new people. She becomes sweet and affectionate once you get to know her. A house or townhouse in the quiet neck of the woods, with a nurturing owner, would be the best fit for Tiny. She could also live in an apartment if it's spacious/quiet with safe zones to call her own - eg baby gates and secluded spaces. A quiet home where she can settle in and thrive would be perfect for Tiny, this means a home without children and pets/dogs. She can do stairs & enjoys sleeping in a crate, however not required. She has shown she can settle for longer periods here and would suit working up to full timers. It would be amazing to see someone nurture her confidence and guide her through the world. She becomes playful, loves chasing toys around, likes treats and food, and walks nicely on the lead. She's happy to take treats and likes learning and training. Tiny is a sweet little dog who will make an amazing pet once she has settled in. If you think Tiny sounds like the right girl for you then apply to meet her today.

NAME: Sophia
TEXT: Meet Sophia – the Sweet & Sophisticated Greyhound! 🐾 Sophia is a gentle 6-year-old greyhound with a calm, easy-going nature. She’s been around kids (ages 5 & 6) who can walk and feed her, and she takes it all in stride! While she might be a little reserved at first, once she feels at home her playful, affectionate side shines through. Sophia gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes and is the perfect mix of grace and goofiness.

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: Ernie is a shy boy who has made a lot of progress at the adoption centre. He is looking for a special home who will nurture him and continue his confidence building. He requires a family willing to take things slow with him as we have here. He would thrive as a solo dog with a 1-2 adults at home, or a calm dog to keep him company. He could spend a few hours alone or longer, with a secure yard or courtyard. He is very sweet, cuddle and adorable once he trusts you (see photos of all his cuddly moments!). It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Rita
TEXT: Meet Rita💛 Rita is a lovely greyhound with a wonderfully relaxed outlook on life. She’s the kind of girl who takes everything in her stride — calm, content, and always happy to go with the flow. With her gentle nature and easy going temperament, Rita is a true pleasure to have around. She gets along beautifully with her fellow greyhounds and enjoys spending time with other medium and large dogs too. Whether she’s sharing a quiet snooze or having a gentle wander with her canine friends, Rita is friendly and well-mannered in every situation. Rita has that special “cruising through life” attitude — nothing seems to bother her, and she’s just as happy relaxing in the sunshine as she is joining in for a stroll or some family time. With her calm presence and kind heart, Rita would make a wonderful addition to almost any home. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a peaceful, loving dog who will fit effortlessly into daily life.

NAME: Violet
TEXT: Friendly, energetic and adorable girl Violet is a sweet and reserved girl to begin with but loves to play and bounce around once she gets to know you. Violet walks perfectly on the lead and is polite and friendly with other dogs her size. We think her confidence would grow if she had a doggie friend to spend her days with. A backyard or townhouse yard would be a perfect fit for Violet! Meet Violet by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Angus is friendly and playful, likes playing with toys and confident in new places. Angus is active, fun and would enjoy a active, structured life of daily walks and adventures. Someone confident with walking a strong dog is preferred as he can be excited to get going. Angus would be a great candidate to share a home with another medium to large dog pal! Meet Angus by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: *I have been in a foster care home for 6 weeks - read the update below!* "Sully is going well and has settled in and shows signs of improvement almost everyday. He is very good with children and with all types of dogs. He loves a walk and is good on the lead. On the lead he is well behaved and does not respond when other dog are walking near him. If I stop and talk with another dog walker Sully is calm and relates appropriately with other dogs. Sully loves to drive in the car and enjoys the wind in his face as he keeps his head out of the window. He loves a cuddle and pat in the morning and anytime during the day if he is awake." ------------ Hi, I’m Sully — a gentle, quiet-natured blue boy looking for my new home. I love being around my people, get along well with other dogs, and I’m perfectly happy spending time in the yard while you’re out. I also love having the freedom to wander in and out as I please. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. I like to take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and enjoy the fresh air throughout the day. I also like to sleep outside and would love a family who respects my boundaries when I’m resting or asleep. I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available now at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Sonic
TEXT: Ready to meet Sonic—the greyhound who’s not just fast but also the speediest chill master you’ll ever know? If there were an Olympic event for maximum chill, Sonic would take home the gold every time. This laid-back gentleman has mastered the art of relaxation and cruises through life like he’s on a permanent Sunday afternoon. Whether it’s sprawling out on the couch or making himself comfy in a new spot, Sonic just gets how to settle in and make any place feel like home. Sonic is the kind of dog who never rushes, never worries, and never gets ruffled. He’s the perfect blend of calm and friendly—always happy to say hello to new dog friends, no matter their size. Tiny pups? Big fluffy dogs? Sonic’s got the patience and easy-going charm to get along with them all. And families, listen up—Sonic would be a dream companion for kids! He’s gentle, tolerant, and totally cool with the hustle and bustle that comes with a lively household. Whether it’s playtime or downtime, he’s happy to join in or just hang out, soaking up the love and good vibes. If you want a mellow, sweet, and endlessly loving buddy who makes life feel a little more relaxed and a lot more fun, Sonic’s your guy. Ready to invite this cruising king of calm into your home? He’s already made himself comfy in our hearts and can’t wait to do the same with you!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a playful, sweet-natured boy with a cheeky streak and a big heart. He’s lived with a young cattle dog puppy and showed plenty of patience, and he currently shares his life with a couple of toddlers who climb all over him—he doesn’t mind a bit! Jack LOVES his toys (especially fetch!) and is super treat-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze. He’s all about having a good play, then flopping onto a comfy bed for a well-earned nap. Jack’s also been known to “reorganise” shoes around the house—just his way of helping with interior design! If you’re after a fun-loving, kid-friendly companion with a mischievous grin and a heart of gold, Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Burt
TEXT: Burt is a total character who thrives on human attention and isn’t shy about making sure you notice him! He can pull like a pro at first on walks, but give him a little time and he settles right down. Burt gets along with other greyhounds at home but prefers to be the king of his castle—he’s got a strong “mine” vibe when it comes to his food and toys. He’s great with kids of all ages and has plenty of experience being a patient, lovable buddy. Burt’s looking for someone who’s home most of the time to keep him company and soak up all his charm. Cats aren’t really his cup of tea, so a feline-free home would suit him best. Ready for a lively, loyal companion? Burt’s your guy!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a calm and quiet lady who walks well on lead and prefers a relaxed lifestyle—perfect for someone looking for a low-key companion. She enjoys a little play with toys now and then, plus the occasional zoomie to remind you she’s still got some pep in her step. Bertha is best suited as a solo dog and would be a wonderful match for someone who wants a peaceful friend to share their days with—especially if you work from home and can keep her company. While she’s not a fan of cats, Bertha’s easy-going nature makes her a sweet and steady companion for the right home.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a confident, energetic guy who walks beautifully on lead and loves to bound around with enthusiasm. He’s super engaging with people and thrives on treats—perfect for training and bonding! While Jimmy enjoys playing with other greyhounds during his outings, he prefers to be the only dog in the home to keep things calm and comfortable. Jimmy hasn’t had much experience with cats and tends to prefer a pet-free feline zone, so a cat-free home would be best. Jimmy would shine in an active household where he can join in on plenty of adventures and daily fun. If you’re looking for a lively, loyal, Jimmy is your guy!

NAME: Jacko
TEXT: Meet Jacko! Jacko is a confident, curious soul who's ready to find a forever home where he can truly shine. With a natural love for exploring the world around him, Jacko would thrive with a single person or a couple who can give him the time, space, and companionship he deserves. While Jacko adores human company, he prefers to be the only pet in the home so he can soak up all the love and attention. He may be open to meeting other dogs his size with slow, careful introductions — but he’s happiest when he has his own space to relax and play. This smart boy has fantastic recall and responds beautifully when out and about, making adventures together a real pleasure. He also enjoys his downtime with toys and will happily entertain himself or engage in a gentle game with his humans. If you're looking for a loyal, playful, and independent companion who's ready to explore life by your side, Jacko might just be your perfect match. Key Info: ✅ Best as a solo pet ✅ Confident and curious ✅ Slower intros with other dogs his size ✅ Excellent recall ✅ Loves toys and enrichment ✅ Ideal for a single person or couple Jacko is ready to meet his person – could that be you?

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Meet Shadow 🐾 Shadow is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound who’s happiest when he’s hanging out with his human family and preferably inside, where he can find the comfiest spot in the house and make it his own. Once he’s picked his perfect chill zone, you’ll barely know he’s there… until it’s time to play or snack, that is! Shadow gets along beautifully with other dogs and adores children of all ages. He’s calm, friendly, and takes everything in his stride, making him a lovely companion for a busy family or anyone looking for a relaxed but social dog. If you’ve got a cat, Shadow may need a slow and gentle introduction—he’s curious but polite, and with a bit of patience, there’s potential for peaceful cohabitation. Despite his relaxed nature, Shadow loves to play, especially a good game of fetch! He’ll light up when you grab a toy and is always ready for some fun in the yard or a quick burst of activity before heading back to his favourite snooze spot. And when the treats come out? Oh, you’ve got his full attention. This boy knows how to sit pretty for a snack and will happily hang out just to be near you. Shadow would thrive in a loving home where he can enjoy the best of both worlds: playtime and cuddle time. Whether you’re a family with kids, a home with other dogs, or someone looking for a loyal companion to share quiet moments and light hearted play, Shadow is ready to step into your life and into your heart.

NAME: Hammer
TEXT: Ready to nail the perfect companion? Meet Hammer 🐾 Hammer is the ultimate all-rounder—a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who gets along famously with other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it’s a tiny terrier or a big labrador, Hammer’s easy going nature means he’s ready to make friends wherever he goes. This lively boy absolutely loves his zoomies and would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can race around and let loose to his heart’s content. When he’s not zooming, Hammer is a wonderful family dog—gentle, affectionate, and great with people of all ages. He’s equally happy as a solo dog or as the perfect companion for a young couple looking for a loving, energetic friend. Hammer is a cuddler at heart and enjoys spending quiet moments snuggled up with his humans after a day of fun and play. His engaging personality and happy disposition make him a joy to be around, always eager to say hello and share some love. If you’re searching for a playful, affectionate, and well-rounded greyhound who’s ready to bring energy and warmth into your home, Hammer might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Big Boy
TEXT: Say hello to Big Boy 🐾 Big Boy is a gentle giant with a heart as big as his name! This confident and max relaxer greyhound is a true people pleaser who adores everyone—from dogs and cats to children of all ages. He’s got a warm, friendly nature that makes him an instant hit wherever he goes. While Big Boy loves socializing, he prefers to be the king of his castle and would do best as a solo dog in his forever home. That said, he’s always up for a fun doggy playdate to stretch his legs and enjoy some furry friendship time. He knows how to keep things chill and relaxed, so his play dates tend to be happy and harmonious affairs. Big Boy would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can soak up the sunshine, lounge on the grass, or explore at his own leisurely pace. He’s happiest when a family member is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys company but is also perfectly content to kick back and chill solo when needed. Whether he’s snoozing quietly or spending quality time cuddling with his humans, Big Boy’s laid-back vibe brings calm and comfort to any household. On walks, Big Boy is a star walker, calm and confident on the lead, making every outing a peaceful pleasure for both dog and human. If you’re looking for a lovable, relaxed companion who’s a true social butterfly with a preference for solo living and fun play dates, Big Boy could be your perfect match. Ready to settle in and steal your heart, he’s waiting to become the gentle giant of your family!

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🐾 Jett is a confident and outgoing boy with a heart full of love and energy. He has previously lived happily with small dogs, showing his friendly and adaptable nature, and he’s always ready to make new furry friends wherever he goes. This active boy thrives on plenty of exercise and stimulation, but he also knows how to switch gears and settle in for lots of cuddles and affection. Jett absolutely loves being close to his humans and will happily snuggle up whenever he gets the chance. His affectionate nature makes him a true companion who will brighten your days with his joyful spirit. Jett would do best in a home where someone is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys having company around and thrives when he’s not left alone for long periods. His confident and sociable personality means he’s ready to explore the world and enjoy new adventures with you by his side. If you’re looking for an energetic, loving, and confident greyhound who is great with smaller dogs and adores affection, Jett could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Kala
TEXT: Kala is strapping young lad who is a big cuddly softie. He just wants to be part of the family. He is happy to supervise while your working hard around the yard and is happy to fetch toys and drop them at your feet. Kala is destined to be a valued family member with a lot of love to give. Great with everyone he meets. Still needs a bit of patience and guidance to be a great companion.

NAME: Geisha
TEXT: Say hello to Geisha 🐶 Geisha is a beautiful lady with a calm presence, a gentle spirit, and a love for life’s simple pleasures. She has the kind of soothing energy that fills a room without saying a word – just her being there makes everything feel a little more peaceful. True to her name, Geisha moves with grace and serenity, but don’t let that elegant exterior fool you – she’s also got a wonderfully playful streak! When it comes to other dogs, Geisha is a total pro. She’s incredibly dog-social and happy to live with canine companions of all shapes and sizes. Whether she’s gently playing, quietly snoozing next to them, or just sharing her space, she does it all with ease and friendliness. Geisha is what we like to call “effortlessly easy.” She’s wonderfully relaxed, low-maintenance, and happy to go with the flow. She’ll adapt to your routine without complaint and will be your quiet shadow, following you from room to room with calm curiosity. She doesn’t ask for much – just a soft bed, some gentle affection, and maybe a toy or two to keep her entertained. One of her favourite things is simply being close to her humans. She thrives on gentle affection and will happily rest her head in your lap or snuggle in close for some quiet bonding time. She’s affectionate without being needy – just a sweet, steady presence who’s always nearby when you need a bit of comfort or company. Geisha is ready to find her forever home – could it be with you?

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Meet Joe 🐾 Joe is a confident and cheerful gentleman with a tail that never stops wagging! Full of personality and charm, Joe carries himself with a happy-go-lucky attitude and a healthy dose of independence. He knows what he likes — whether it's a good sniff around the backyard or a comfy spot to lounge in, but he’s always happy to come over for a cuddle and soak up all the affection you're willing to give. Joe is great with medium and large dogs, showing good manners and a calm approach. He’s still learning about smaller dogs, so slow and gentle introductions will be key. With the right guidance, he’s a smart boy who’s always up for learning something new. This lovely lad would thrive in a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs and enjoy some solo sunbathing time. Joe’s independent streak means he’s not overly clingy, but he still loves having his humans around — especially if they’re up for some playtime or pats. He’d be best suited to a home with older children who can match his energy and give him the space he needs to relax and feel secure. If you're looking for a happy, affectionate, and self-assured greyhound to brighten your days, Joe could be just the guy for you! 🐶

NAME: Nitro
TEXT: Meet Nitro! ⚡️ Nitro is a lively guy who knows how to strike the perfect balance between zoomies and chill time. When he’s feeling energetic, he’ll happily race around the yard like a little lightning bolt, showing off his speedy moves and playful spirit. But just as quickly, he’s just as content curling up beside you for some serious relaxation and quality cuddle time. Nitro is a true social butterfly in the pet world. He’s cat-friendly and dog-friendly, making him an ideal member of a multi-pet household. Whether he’s sharing space with feline friends or canine companions, Nitro is easy-going, respectful, and gets along famously with everyone. Plus, he’s fantastic with children of all ages; gentle, patient, and always ready to be part of the family fun. This affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention and love. He’s the type of dog who will happily follow you around the house just to be near you, eagerly accepting all the pets, scratches, and belly rubs you can offer. Nitro’s love tank is bottomless, and he’s not shy about letting you know when he needs a little extra TLC. Nitro also appreciates his crate—a cozy, safe haven where he can retreat when he wants some downtime or a peaceful nap after a busy day of adventures and play. He’s well-behaved, adaptable, and loves having a comfy spot to call his own. If you’re searching for a loving, well-rounded companion who fits seamlessly into a bustling household, Nitro might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Bat Man
TEXT: Meet Bat Man! 🦇 Don’t let the name fool you—Bat Man is a laid-back greyhound with a heart as soft as his adorable fluffy coat. He’s happiest when surrounded by his fellow greyhounds, loving their company and enjoying the calm, easy-going life of a true greyhound gentleman. Bat Man hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, but he’s got such a chilled-out nature that we’re hopeful he’d take things in stride with the right introduction. This easy going guy adores his human friends and is always up for some quality time; whether it’s a gentle pat, a slow stroll, or just hanging out together. He’s happy to cruise about at his own relaxed pace, taking in the world with a contented smile. Bat Man’s combination of chilled vibes, fluffy charm, and love for his greyhound pals makes him a wonderful companion for someone looking to add a calm, affectionate friend to their home.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I have just aced my 8 weeks of foster care and I'm ready to go home with you!* Foster Update: "Matey is going great, enjoys his walks, enrichment toys and especially enjoys food! He now comes inside and runs straight to his bed and lies down, without me even needing to tell him, we are blown away with how well he is going!" Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and gentle, curious and affectionate nature, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey suits full time workers and loves spending his days outside with enrichment during the day - making him a great outdoor dog for a family looking for a pet who spends most of their time outside. Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a sweet, quiet girl, who is lovely and soft with other dogs. She warms up well once you get to know her and becomes very sweet and affectionate. Cindy would suit a nurturing home where they can take things slow, but we're sure she will come out of her shell! A quiet home with a backyard to retreat to would be a perfect match for Cindy as she settles into pet life. A home without little kids is best suited as she is on the shy side. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Tails
TEXT: Meet Tails 🐕‍🦺 Tails has been in foster care with a wonderful family and their 2 greyhounds now for a few months. 💕 Tails has flourished in foster with Winnie and Potato teaching her the ropes. She loves going for walks and enjoys the beach. Tails is a collector of all things, she has learnt to clean up her toys and take them to her bed at night. She also collects many other things and looks after them. Tails would benefit from another confident playful greyhound friend like Potato to teach her the ropes and continue to bring out her confidence. Tails loves to play and run with her friend Potato in the yard while Winnie supervises watching fromt he sidelines ready to be the fun police if required.

NAME: Tim Tam
TEXT: Whether you're a double coat, caramel or an original Tim Tam fan, we can all agree Tim Tams are a sweet treat and a family favourite. He is the perfect blend of calm natured and sometimes playful, what more could you want in a canine companion. He walks lovely on the lead and would suit a home without exposure to small dogs. Tim Tam gets along with dogs his size. Due to his friendly nature, he will suit a family that have respectful children. Tim Tam comes when called and is polite around new people! Tim Tam is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wooly
TEXT: Hey, I'm Wooly! I'm a quiet guy, looking for a quiet home. I warm up to new people but would prefer a nurturing chilled out place to call my own. I'd love my own backyard and don't mind mingling with other dogs big or small. I love food and will enjoy learning new tricks in my forever home. A home without children is best for me. I can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Brax
TEXT: Meet Brax 🐾! Brax is a delightful boy with a playful and affectionate personality that instantly wins hearts. He’s had wonderful experience being around small children, showing a calm and gentle demeanour that makes him a fantastic addition to family life. Brax has also seen chickens and cats during his time, though he hasn’t been formally tested with them, so a slow, supervised introduction would help everyone feel comfortable. This handsome boy loves the company of other medium to large dogs and enjoys socializing and playing with his furry pals. Whether it’s a lively play session or just hanging out side by side, Brax thrives in a dog-friendly environment where he can be active and engaged. While he’s full of playful energy, Brax also knows how to relax and truly enjoys lying in his crate, which he finds cozy and safe and a perfect spot to recharge after a busy day. One of his most lovable traits is how much he loves to show affection. He’s not shy about letting you know when he wants some love, and he delights in offering cuddles and warm moments to those he trusts. Brax is looking for a forever home where he can be part of a loving family who appreciates his playful spirit and gentle heart. If you’re seeking a sweet, social, and affectionate greyhound who’s great with kids and loves spending time with other dogs, Brax might be the perfect fit for you!

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a confident, friendly and affectionate girl described as 'wonderful' by her trainers here at the adoption centre. If you're looking for a super smart and focused girl, Jill's known cues are: name/recall, 'on your bed', off, down, touch, shake, chin rest, and drop (a toy). Jill loves toys & will play fetch with you. Her ideal home is a house with a backyard with colorbond fencing with shorter hours alone while she settles in. Jill requires a home without exposure to other dogs and requires an owner who lives in a low small dog populated area. She would thrive with an experienced greyhound owner who can continue her human engagement, training, focus training, and things like stationing on a bed, performing cues and recalling. She is happy to entertain herself in the yard during the day making her a good fit for those who work full-time and want a loving companion welcome them home everyday. Meet Jill at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spring
TEXT: Meet Spring! 🌼 Spring is a sweet-natured girl with a heart as soft as her gorgeous greyhound coat. She’s one of those dogs who makes life easier just by being around – relaxed, gentle, and incredibly easy to handle. Whether you’re an experienced dog owner or new to life with pups, Spring fits in effortlessly. She’s a real social butterfly, getting along brilliantly with all other dogs and loving the company of people. If you’ve got visitors, expect Spring to be first in line for a gentle hello and a little tail wag. She's a friendly soul who just wants to be included in the love. Spring would be a great fit for a family home, including one with respectful children. Her calm and steady personality makes her a safe and lovely companion for little ones. While she’s a joy in almost every way, Spring is still working on perfecting her lead manners – nothing too tricky, just a bit of ongoing training and consistency, and she’ll have it down in no time. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance, and loving dog who enjoys companionship and will bring a peaceful energy to your home, Spring could be your perfect match.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a happy, vibrant and energetic girl who is affectionate and social! She loves all the fun things in pet life - treats, zoomies, attention and play! She would love a fun active home to keep her stimulated and meet her training and enrichment needs. She is very friendly, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She would suit kids experienced with large breed dogs. A fully fenced yard with somewhere for her to romp around and sunbake would be ideal for Belle! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Dina
TEXT: Hi, I'm Dina, I'm a shy but sweet girl looking for someone to nurture and calm my nerves. I am sweet and polite and I promise to be your new best friend, I'm just a little unsure when I first meet you. I take a bit of time to warm up, so I'd like a quiet neck of the woods to call my own, maybe a house with a quiet yard or a nice property to relax on. I am polite, calm and friendly around other dogs, too! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Rev
TEXT: Meet Rev ⚡! Rev is a handsome and energetic boy who loves nothing more than making new friends—both human and canine alike. With excellent recall, he’s eager to listen and respond, but he does have a strong lead presence that means he’d benefit from a bit more training to help him channel all that enthusiasm in the best way possible. Rev is incredibly social and friendly, and he’ll always be the first to say hi with a wagging tail and a big smile. His love for other greyhounds is clear—he thrives when he’s around his own kind, enjoying playful interactions and company that keeps his spirits high. An explorer at heart, Rev is happiest when he’s out and about, taking in new sights and scents with boundless curiosity and energy. He’s ready for an active home that can keep up with his zest for life and support his ongoing training to help him become the best version of himself. If you’re looking for a friendly, lively, and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to share adventures and endless greetings, Rev is your guy!

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Meet Gem 💎! This gorgeous girl has a heart full of love and a gentle, shy nature that takes a little time to come out of her shell. At first, Gem might feel a bit reserved as she gets used to new surroundings and people, but with patience and a calm environment, she quickly settles in and reveals her true, loving self. Gem would thrive best in a household where someone is usually around—whether working from home, part-time, or just a steady presence—so she never feels alone and can build her confidence at her own pace. One of Gem’s greatest joys is spending time with her doggy friends. She loves to play and interact with other dogs, showing her friendly and sociable side once she feels comfortable. Gem also adores children and enjoys their playful energy, making her a wonderful companion for families with kids who can engage her in gentle games and fun activities. Though she may start off a little shy, once Gem has warmed up to you, she’s a total cuddle queen. She loves curling up close, soaking in affection, and sharing those quiet, cozy moments that truly bond a dog and their human. Her sweet, gentle spirit shines through in these calm times, reminding you just how special she is. If you’re looking for a patient, loving, and devoted friend who will blossom beautifully in a supportive and caring home, Gem is waiting to meet you. With time, love, and consistency, this gentle girl will become a treasured member of your family, bringing warmth and happiness every day.

NAME: Snooty
TEXT: Snooty is a charming boy with a heart full of love and a tail that’s always wagging. Snooty walks beautifully on lead and loves getting out and about, making him the perfect company for an adventure or an afternoon stroll. Snooty is super affectionate and friendly and he absolutely adores pats and scratches! He’s also a social butterfly who has shown positive interactions with dogs of all sizes, so pending a meet and greet, may suit a home with a canine friend. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s as gentle as he is joyful, Snooty is your guy. Apply now!

NAME: Sunny
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sunny! Like a perfect spring day, the sun is shining, and I promise to be a bright and happy presence in your life! I am a calm, loving boy. I am happy, easy going and engaging, quite charismatic if I do say so myself. I would love a fenced yard to call my own, so I can enjoy my sunbaking zoomies. Due to my charming nature I'd do well in a home with other dog/s big or small. I hope my gorgeous nature shines through the screen, and that you can't wait to meet me, because I am a polite and laid back boy who can't wait to meet you! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Lonnie
TEXT: Hey, I'm Lonnie! With my big happy smile, I hope I catch your eye! I'm a friendly girl to people and dogs alike, making me a wonderful family pet. I walk perfectly on the lead, and I have a lovely gentle personality. I like car rides, adventures and having fun with my people. I would love a home who will show me all about the big wide world and include me in daily activities. I have a soft, gentle personality and would love to meet you! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Hi, I'm angel, a gentle mannered quiet girl looking for a forever home. I'm middle aged, making me sweet and calm and ready to snooze by your side. I can take a little time to warm up but I promise to be your best friend once I get to know you. Another dog does give me some more confidence so maybe you have a confident doggie for me to be friends with? I'd love a courtyard or backyard to call my own, as I love being outside in the sunshine. Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Sooky 🐾 Sooky is a beautiful girl with a soft heart and a gentle spirit. She’s the kind of girl who doesn’t ask for much — just a calm home, a comfy spot inside, and someone who understands her sensitive nature. Sooky can be a little unsure when left alone for long periods, so she'd do best in a home where she has access to the indoors during the day, especially if her humans are out. Having that safe, familiar space helps ease her anxiety and lets her settle in comfortably. She currently lives on a property with a cattle dog and gets along well, so she could definitely benefit from having another calm, furry companion to keep her company. Sooky is small dog workable, and with a slow and respectful introduction, she may also be cat workable — she’s happy to coexist and just vibe out with her friends. This lovely girl has no need for chaos — she’s all about the peaceful life. She enjoys a quiet day, a gentle stroll, and the comfort of knowing she’s not alone. Whether she’s lying in a sunny patch of grass or relaxing on the couch, Sooky brings a quiet calm wherever she goes. If you're looking for a sweet, sensitive greyhound who just wants a peaceful home, a bit of company, and a place to feel safe, Sooky might just be the perfect fit.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris 🐾 Looking for a big-hearted best mate with extra-long legs and even longer cuddle sessions? Say hello to Boris — a supersized sweetheart who’s equal parts lounge lizard and lovebug! The only way to describe him is…. A gentle giant. Boris is a big boy (and he knows it!), but don’t let his size fool you — he’s a total softie who lives for snuggles and affection. If there’s a comfy spot and a human nearby, Boris is already there, leaning in for pats and making himself right at home. He loves hanging out with his fellow greyhounds and is a bit of a social butterfly in the dog world. Whether it's chilling in the backyard or going for a casual group walk, Boris is all about the good vibes and friendly company. Car rides? Trailer trips? No worries! Boris is calm, cool, and collected on the move. He travels like a seasoned pro — just give him a spot to settle and he’s happy to watch the world go by (or take a nap en route to his next adventure). Boris would love a home where he can lounge around, share his oversized heart, and maybe steal a spot on the couch (or at least a corner!). If you’re after a chill, cuddly, and all-around lovely lad to complete your family — Boris is ready to roll right into your life and never look back.

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Meet Danny 🐕 Danny is a charming and affectionate boy with a big heart and a friendly soul. He absolutely adores other greyhounds and thrives in their company. Although he hasn’t been tested around smaller dogs yet, his gentle and calm nature suggests he could adapt well with the right introduction. Danny has lived happily with young children and has proven to be a patient and loving friend to the little ones in his life. He’s used to the hustle and bustle of a busy home and enjoys being part of a family environment where he can share lots of love and attention. One of Danny’s standout qualities is how beautifully he walks on the lead — calm, polite, and well-mannered, he makes every walk a pleasant experience. He’s also very trainable and responds well to crate training, which helps him settle and feel secure when needed. Danny would do best in a home that has a backyard or safe outdoor space where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some fresh air, and have the freedom to relax and play. He’s not just an energetic pup; he’s a true people-lover who thrives on companionship and bonds closely with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly, and devoted greyhound who will fit seamlessly into a loving home, Danny could be your perfect match. He’s ready to share his heart and make new memories with a family that can give him the care and affection he deserves.

NAME: Lawsie
TEXT: Meet Lawsie 🐾 Lawsie is a vibrant and confident boy who’s bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This lively boy loves nothing more than spending time with his fellow greyhounds — their company really makes him shine. With a slow and careful introduction, Lawsie can also learn to get along well with small dogs, though he’s better suited to a household that understands his playful and excitable nature. Lawsie thrives in a home with older children who can keep up with his high energy and enjoy joining in on his fun adventures. He’s happiest when he’s zooming around, chasing his favorite toys, and letting loose with the classic greyhound zoomies that will bring a smile to anyone’s face. His playful spirit and bright personality make him a true bundle of joy to be around. While Lawsie is friendly and outgoing, he is a bit stronger on the lead due to his excitement, so some patient lead training will help him focus and walk calmly by your side. This little guy is eager to learn and wants to impress his new family! If you’re looking for a confident, happy-go-lucky companion who will fill your home with energy and love, Lawsie could be the perfect match. He’s ready to bring endless fun and affection to a patient family who can match his pace and appreciate his wonderful personality.

NAME: Speedy
TEXT: Meet Speedy 🐕‍🦺 Speedy is a true friend to all dogs and thrives on socializing with his canine companions. He’s incredibly friendly and easy going, but when it comes to smaller pups, he appreciates those who are confident and respectful—he knows how to set boundaries without fuss. With the right doggy friends, Speedy blossoms into the perfect playmate and loyal buddy, making him an ideal addition to a multi-dog household where everyone gets along peacefully. Travel is no trouble for Speedy; in fact, he’s always eager to hop in the van and go on new adventures. Whether it’s a quick trip to the park, a visit to the vet, or a day out exploring, Speedy handles car rides like a seasoned pro. His calm demeanour makes traveling stress-free and enjoyable for everyone involved. On walks, Speedy is a dream. He walks beautifully on the lead, matching your pace with effortless grace and a happy tail wag. His cruisy personality shines through every step, making your daily strolls a pleasure rather than a chore. Beyond his sociable nature with dogs and his love for travel, Speedy has a wonderfully happy and relaxed attitude towards life. He’s content to chill at home, soak up some sun, or simply be near his humans, always with a calm, gentle presence that brings peace to any household. If you’re looking for a well-mannered, sociable, and super laid-back companion who loves life, good company, and peaceful adventures, Speedy is the one to meet. With his loving nature and easy going spirit, he’s ready to cruise his way into your heart and home.

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Meet Millie 🌿 Millie is a lovely greyhound with a gentle spirit who tends to be a little nervous in new situations. She needs some encouragement and lots of patience as she learns to feel safe and comfortable in her new surroundings. With the right support, Millie will blossom into a loving and devoted companion. Because Millie is shy, she would benefit hugely from foster care, where she can receive one-on-one attention and gentle guidance during her initial settling-in phase. A quiet, calm household would be the perfect environment for her to grow in confidence without feeling overwhelmed. Millie is good with cats and would happily share her home with them. When it comes to other dogs, she’ll need a slow and careful introduction to build trust and feel at ease. With time and gentle encouragement, she can learn to enjoy canine company. This special girl is looking for someone with a kind heart who understands that patience and love are the keys to helping her settle in and feel truly at home. If you have a calm space and the time to nurture Millie’s confidence, she could be the perfect addition to your life.

NAME: Dancer
TEXT: Meet Dancer 💃 Dancer is a beautiful girl with a quiet charm and a soul full of tenderness. A little shy at first, she takes her time to get comfortable in new surroundings—but once she gets to know you, she reveals the sweetest, most affectionate side of herself. She loves companionship but prefers to make the first move. Once she feels safe, she’ll come to you for affection. Dancer is looking for a calm, peaceful home where she can truly relax and come into her own. A quieter household, free from too much hustle and bustle, would suit her best—somewhere she can settle at her own pace and feel secure. She’d do well with older, respectful children who can give her the gentle space she needs to flourish. She’s wonderfully polite with other animals and gets along well with both dogs and cats. Whether she joins a home with other calm pets or becomes your one and only, she’ll be a loyal and loving presence once she finds her confidence. This lovely girl isn’t looking for loud excitement or constant attention—just a safe place, kind people, and the chance to build a bond that runs deep. With a little time, a lot of love, and plenty of patience, Dancer will reward you with quiet loyalty and a heart full of trust. Dancer is ready to find her soft place to land.

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: This sweet girl has entered her golden years and is ready to find her forever home! Georgia warms up to new people in no time and loves affection, often leaning in for more pats and scratches behind the ear (an easy way to win her over!). Georgia would prefer a quieter home with a laid back life style so she can spend her days upside down on a couch or catching rays in the yard. A home with adults or older children would also best suit Georgia. She gets a long well with other Greyhounds so pending a meet and greet, could suit a home with another medium to large canine friend. Meet Georgia at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jerry
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jerry! I love kids aged 2 up and have lots of experience with them, I'm gentle and love the attention if I'm honest! I'm overall laid back & gentle, and have done all sorts of things to get ready to be your perfect pet, including meeting a staghound & Great Dane x. I'm super easy on lead, not an active dog but loves attention when seeing visitors, and would love to get out and have a play with you in the yard during the day! I like travelling in cars and vans, easy to walk on the lead and love playing with squeaky toys. I could live with other dogs male or female, and I'm ready to show off my happy go lucky energy!

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a sweet and gentle soul who’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace. She can be a little shy to start, but with patience and kindness, she’ll begin to show you just how affectionate and loving she truly is. Jill would be best suited to a quieter lifestyle, where she can feel safe, secure, and take things one step at a time. With slow and careful introductions, she could potentially be okay around smaller dogs, especially those who are calm and respectful. If you’re looking for a soft-natured companion who will quietly steal your heart, Jill might be the perfect match.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Meet Bob 🐾 Introducing Bob, a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, easy-going nature. Bob is the kind of companion who doesn’t need much – just a quiet home, some treats, and a loving human (or two) to call his own. Bob is friendly with other dogs, cat-tolerant, and would do well in a home with older, respectful children. His gentle demeanour and soft, soulful eyes make him a peaceful presence, and he’s happiest when surrounded by the people he loves. This sweet boy has so much affection to give and loves nothing more than being close to his human family. He’s more than happy to chill out for most of the day, watching the world go by from a comfy spot in the house, or curling up next to you for some quiet company. Bob isn’t looking for adventure – just a calm, loving home where he can feel safe, relaxed, and cherished. If you’re after a loyal companion who will bring peace, love, and gentle tail wags into your life, Bob might just be the perfect match. He’s ready to settle down and soak up all the love his forever family has to offer – could that be you?

NAME: Nicko
TEXT: Meet Nicko 💤 🐾 Looking for a calm, low-maintenance companion to match your relaxed lifestyle? Nicko might be your perfect match. This laid-back greyhound boy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. With his gentle nature and love for the quiet life, Nicko would thrive in a peaceful home with someone who enjoys a slower pace and values the joy of simple companionship. Nicko is incredibly relaxed around other dogs and enjoys the company of canine friends. He’s also shown a calm curiosity around children, making him a lovely addition to a home with respectful kids who understand his mellow vibe. And here's a bonus – Nicko could live with a cat! With a careful and slow introduction, he may adapt well to a feline housemate, making him a rare gem in the greyhound world. Nicko isn't the type to demand constant attention or high-energy adventures – a comfy bed, a few gentle walks, and the quiet presence of his human(s) is all he needs to be content. He’s ideal for someone who works from home, is retired, or simply prefers the comfort of a more peaceful routine. If you’re ready to share your life with a sweet, chilled-out greyhound who just wants to be near you and enjoy the calm moments, Nicko is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Meet Emma 🐾 Say hello to Emma, a gentle, affectionate, and quietly charming greyhound with a heart full of love. With her graceful presence and calm nature, Emma is the kind of dog who quickly becomes the heart of any home. She loves nothing more than spending time with her people – whether that’s relaxing on the couch, following you around the house, or just being nearby while you work or unwind. Emma walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys her daily strolls, especially when she gets to catch up with her greyhound friends. She’s well-mannered around other medium to large dogs and has a calm, friendly way about her that makes her easy to get along with. Emma is also great with children and would be a wonderful companion for a family or a household with visiting grandkids. While she’s happy to snooze the day away in true greyhound fashion, Emma does best when she has company. She would thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time – whether you work part-time or from home, Emma will be your loyal and loving sidekick. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with lots of love to give, Emma is ready to steal your heart and become your new best friend.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾🌟 Charlie is a gentle, slightly reserved greyhound who quickly warms up once he feels settled and safe. This calm and affectionate boy enjoys exploring the world through his nose, taking in all the smells and sights on his sniffing adventures. Charlie thrives on companionship and would be happiest in a home where he can be part of the family’s daily life. He’s great with other dogs and cats, making him an ideal addition to a multi-pet household. Charlie’s easy-going nature means he adapts well to new environments, especially with a little patience and time to adjust. Charlie would do best in a home where he isn’t left alone for long periods. He loves having company, whether that’s a family with kids to keep him entertained or someone who works from home or part-time, so he never feels lonely. If you’re looking for a sweet, adaptable companion who loves to explore and enjoys the company of both humans and other pets, Charlie is ready to be your loyal friend. Charlie would be most suited to: A multi-pet household with dogs and/or cats A family environment with children who can provide gentle companionship A home where someone is present part-time or works from home An owner or family willing to give him time and patience to settle in A calm and loving environment where he can enjoy daily sniffing adventures and relaxed walks If Charlie sounds like your perfect match, do not hesitate to come and meet him!

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Meet Archie 🐾 ✨ Archie is a truly wonderful boy with a heart full of social spirit and a calm, confident nature. He absolutely adores spending time with other greyhounds and is happiest when he has a canine buddy by his side. Archie is great with medium to large dogs and fits perfectly into a multi-dog home where he can enjoy plenty of furry company. But it’s not just other dogs that Archie loves — he’s incredibly social and affectionate with people too! Archie thrives on human interaction and is always eager to make new friends, whether it’s a quick pat or some relaxed downtime together. His easy-going temperament means he’s not phased by much — busy environments, new places, or changes in routine don’t rattle this laid-back boy. Archie would do well in a home with older children who understand how to respect boundaries and enjoy gentle play. His calm and steady demeanour makes him a wonderful companion for families, singles, or anyone looking for a loyal, loving dog who’s ready to be part of the family. If you want a confident, friendly, and adaptable greyhound who gets along with both dogs and humans alike, Archie is the perfect match!

NAME: Kingsley
TEXT: King is a wonderful boy who likes to chase after toys and play. He has great recall and comes when called. He is a great companion and very affectionate. He has been living around a mixture of native and domestic animals.

NAME: Val
TEXT: Val is a cuddly and affectionate softie. He will love to be around you when your home and play with toys and love going for walks with you. He would make an excellent addition to the family.

NAME: Tito
TEXT: If you're after a happy, friendly greyhound with a love for life, Tito is your guy! This cheerful boy is bursting with personality and with treats, toys and some love, his tail will always be wagging. Tito loves engaging with the new people he meets while he's out and about and wouldn't mind a home with older kids to match his playful spirit. He’d do best in a home with a backyard where he can have a play, do some zoomies or catch some rays ☀️ Tito may suit a home with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet to make sure it's the right fit for everyone! He’s also a star in the crate, happily munching on treats and chilling out. If you're ready for a life full of joy, play, and tail wags, Tito is the guy for you. Come and meet him at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jitter
TEXT: Meet Jitter 🌸 Say hello to Jitter, a beautiful senior lady with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul. She’s in her golden years and is now searching for the perfect place to enjoy the peaceful, loving retirement she so deeply deserves. Jitter is the definition of easy-going. She’s friendly, affectionate, and content to go with the flow. She’s fantastic with other dogs – big and small – and is also completely cat-friendly, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes. She’s also happy to share her space with children, as long as they’re the calm, gentle type who understand her love for quiet companionship. While Jitter enjoys affection – especially a soft pat and a warm cuddle – she’s also totally fine doing her own thing. She’s independent in the best way, happy to potter around the house or snooze in a comfy spot nearby while you go about your day. She doesn’t demand attention, but she’ll always be ready for a cuddle when you are. Jitter would thrive in a calm, relaxed household where she can enjoy the simple pleasures: soft beds, gentle hands, a quiet garden or sunny windowsill, and the company of people and pets who appreciate her peaceful energy. She’s not the type to bounce around or seek adventure – instead, she’s looking for a home filled with comfort, love, and understanding. Jitter is a low-maintenance, high-love kind of girl who will bring calm, comfort, and quiet joy to the right home. Let her spend her golden years knowing she’s truly loved.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is the sweetest boy a heart full of love and legs built for adventure. This playful boy is looking for his forever home where he can shine as either your one-and-only or alongside another medium to large dog who matches his energy and style. 🐾 Personality & Temperament: Playful & affectionate – Jimmy loves to play and thrives on human interaction. Walk enthusiast – Walks are his favorite part of the day, and he’ll happily trot beside you rain or shine. Kid-friendly – Best suited to homes with older children who understand gentle dog manners. 🏡 Ideal Home: Jimmy would do best in a home where he’s either the only pet or paired with another dog of similar size. He’s not suited to living with small dogs or cats, but he’s got plenty of love to give to his human family.

NAME: Zara
TEXT: Zara is a chilled and easy going girl Zara would like a quiet home where she can chill with her family and perhaps go on a short walk every few days Zara has been living in a home and is quiet and easy to live with Zara has been socialised with small dogs and would be fine with a relaxed quiet small friend

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a vibrant and playful greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He would thrive in an active home with a yard to run around in and older kids to keep him company. Bob is high on life, he loves his zoomies, enjoys playing with toys (his absolute favourite activity), and is always up for a cuddle once he’s had his fun. He walks well on lead and is very social, enjoying the company of people and other dogs. While he’s not a fan of cats, he might do well with a medium to small dog in the home, provided introductions are done slowly and with care. Bob travels beautifully in the car and takes everything in stride. He will need an experienced owner or someone patient and understanding, as he may take a little time to learn house manners and settle into a routine. He’s smart, enthusiastic, and eager to please, he just needs the right guidance. Overall, Bob is just happy to be here. With the right family, he’s going to be an incredibly fun and loving companion.

NAME: Gary
TEXT: Hey mate, the names Gary, good to meet ya! I am a lovely, happy boy, and pretty much a friend to everyone I've met. Everyone loves Gary, if I do say so myself! I'll wag my tail like crazy, probably do a zoomie, but I don't mind my down time too mate! I reckon I could get along with your dog if you've already got one at home, and even those little trouble makers at home, I figure kids would be great fun, more attention for ol' Gary! Give me a backyard or a townhouse and I'll make myself right at home. I might not have been a pet before but I have such a can do attitude, I'll fit in anywhere. Come meet Gaz at Western Sydney.

NAME: José
TEXT: Hi! I have just met you and I love you! I'm José, a friendly, confident boy, I love people, pats and attention! I hope you can see how full of love I am from my cute photos. I will put my head on you and ask for more pats! I'm a sweet guy who is good around other dogs, including mingling with small dogs at times. I don't mind chilling out in a crate but I don't need one! I'd love a backyard, a social life, adventures, and maybe even children to give me lots of pats and adoration, too! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Pat
TEXT: Hi, I'm Pat! I promise to be the bestest boy ever! I hope you like me too. I am a very friendly and affectionate boy. I love food and can be a little shy. I am called a lounge lizard by my current family. I've even done things like go to the beach, meet children, and see the sights on street walks. I don't really show much interest in toys but I have perfected the greyhound zoomie. A paddock gallop is my 'happy place'. I hope you have a backyard for me to chill out in! You can meet me and "Pat me" at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He is highly engaged with his training, best suited to house/townhouse living and settles alone well in a backyard setting. He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like 'down', shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play till his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. His best home is a family who want to do dog training, adventures and cool fun activities with him! Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Meet Pebbles! 🐶 Pebbles is a bright, bubbly, and super social greyhound who’s ready to win hearts wherever she goes! This lovely lady has a big personality and an even bigger heart — she adores the company of other dogs and gets along with absolutely everyone she meets, both two-legged and four. Pebbles has been well-socialised in the community and is comfortable and confident in a variety of environments. She’s spent plenty of time indoors and knows how to settle into home life with ease. Whether she's out and about or relaxing at home, Pebbles is always engaged, curious, and tuned into her humans. She’s a huge fan of pats, cuddles, and—of course—treats! Show her a snack and she’ll be your best friend in an instant. Her friendly, affectionate nature makes her a joy to be around, and she’s always up for a chat (or at least a tail wag and a nuzzle). Pebbles would thrive in a home where she can continue being part of the action—whether it’s social outings, doggy playdates, or simply lounging at your feet after a day full of love and attention. If you're looking for a sweet, sociable girl who’s already got the hang of home life and is ready to be your loyal companion, Pebbles is your perfect match.

NAME: Bobby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Bobby! a sweet, affectionate boy with a big heart and a love for close company. 🐶💛 Bobby has experience mingling with medium to large dogs, including a German Shepherd, and would thrive in a home with another friendly dog to keep him company and help him feel secure. He’s wonderful inside the home and is happiest when snuggled up on the couch or bed with his people. Bobby would suit a family with older children who can enjoy playtime and give him the gentle guidance he needs. A home with a secure yard and experienced owners would be ideal, as Bobby is still building his confidence and will benefit from patient support to help him express himself and continue to grow. With the right environment and lots of love, Bobby will blossom into an incredibly loyal and loving companion. Meet Bobby at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Son
TEXT: Hi, I'm Son! I've been described as calm, loving, sociable, and easy going! I'm happy travelling, snoozing in crates, snuggling into new people for a bit of attention and pats. I've got a charming nature and I think I'm pretty adaptable in new situations! I would suit respectful kids and a backyard to search for my toys in! I'm a confident fella who can't wait to meet you. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Edi
TEXT: Hi, I'm Edi! I was born on Christmas Day! I can be shy around new people but I promise to be a total love bug once I know you! I'm learning about all things "pet" right now including being indoors, things like couches and TV's are pretty cool! I also like the crate, and the splashy pool in summer! I'm learning about busy streets and have mingled with kids, too. I am quiet, affectionate, calm and friendly and hope you would like to come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: With his sweet little undershot jaw, Diesel oozes character both on the outside and on the inside! This sweet dog is good with children and other dogs, he is ready to slot right into family life and find a sofa to call his own. Whist he loves to play ball and goof around, Diesel is also happy to curl up next to his person for a cuddle and a snooze!

NAME: Harper
TEXT: Harper is a loveable girl who keeps life interesting in the best way possible! Her quirky, fun-loving nature is sure to bring smiles and laughter to her new home. She has learnt her name and can recall on the lead, and loves to lay down on any bed possible, anywhere and everywhere! She is a very sweet natured girl and loves to play with other greyhounds here, too. She’s full of excitement when she’s outside but once she’s indoors, Harper settles in and loves being close to her people. She does cope fine on her own, especially indoors. She would thrive in a home with older kids. An owner willing to continue her training around smaller breeds of dogs will see Harper succeed as she would benefit from ongoing exposure. If you’re after a sweet, silly, and affectionate companion with a big personality and an even bigger heart, Harper is ready to move in and make your days brighter. Harper can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris! 🐕 Boris is a high-energy, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. With his confident nature and bouncy enthusiasm, he’s always ready to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. Boris gets along great with medium to large dogs and would thrive in an active home where he can be part of the action. Whether it’s going on adventures, playing in the yard, or just enjoying time with his people, Boris is all in. He would also love a friend at home to keep him company and is happy to play with him. If you’re an energetic family looking for a lively, loving companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Boris is your guy!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Gazza is a sweet boy who travels well in vans, cars and trailer, also walks well on lead on adventures out and about. Gazza has shown polite manners with children ranging from 20 months to 9 years old, showing a gentle & polite indifference. Gazza has spent time mingling with big and small dogs and would suit a home looking for a laid back boy happy to go with the flow. Gazza dreams of a little backyard to spend his days in and kids to keep him entertained during the day. He can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert 🐾 Albert is a quiet, clean, and gentle soul who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s the kind of greyhound who takes life in his stride—literally! He walks beautifully on the lead, travels like a pro, and is an all-around easy companion. While he can be a little shy at first, Albert warms up quickly and really comes into his own once he’s settled. He absolutely loves a good run with his canine pals and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Albert would thrive in a calm, loving home where he can enjoy his daily walks, zoomies with friends, and a comfy spot to relax. If you're looking for a sweet, well-mannered boy with a playful side, Albert might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Meet Grace ☀️ Grace is a calm, friendly girl with a beautifully chilled personality and a love for the simple things in life — like a sunny spot to nap in and the company of other dogs. She’s previously lived happily with other canine companions and would love a home where she can continue to enjoy that friendship. She would be equally as happy being an only dog with her human friends. Grace has lived inside a home before; she walks nicely on the lead and travels well — making outings easy and enjoyable. Whether she's strolling beside you or stretching out in the sunshine, Grace brings a gentle, contented energy wherever she goes. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate and independent and would thrive in a home that appreciates her relaxed nature and loving heart. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s happy to share her space, her sunshine, and her heart — Grace is ready to meet you.

NAME: Edna
TEXT: Meet Edna 🌸 Edna is a lovely, soft-natured girl with a quiet charm and a heart full of potential. She enjoys the company of other dogs and her human friends. Edna walks beautifully on the lead and travels calmly, making her a joy to take out and about. While she may be a little shy at first, given time and gentle encouragement, she begins to show her sweet, affectionate personality. She would thrive in a quieter home where she can take things slowly and build confidence with patient people by her side, especially as she navigates new environments at her own pace. Once she feels settled, Edna blossoms — and her gentle companionship is truly special. If you're looking for a loyal friend to love and nurture, Edna might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Horse
TEXT: Meet Horse 🐾 Horse might have a big name, but he’s a total softie at heart. This gorgeous boy is the definition of laid-back – calm, collected, and always up for a cuddle or a tasty treat (he’s a bit of a snack connoisseur!).
